SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) AS diagnoza_kapitola, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prum_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prum_cena_na_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 263 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE '%I10%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni AND v.body > 3 AND z.cena > 8869.68 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 12 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 87 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkem_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_stejne_skupiny, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 345 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) < 11 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu_stejne_skupiny DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_stejne_pojistovny, SUM(v1.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z1.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(v1.body) DESC) AS rank_celkem_bodu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 180 AND p1.drg_skupina IN (787, 408, 744) AND v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 8216 AND SUM(z1.cena) < 928038.98 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, celkem_zup_cena ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace_sdruzenych_pripadu, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) / NULLIF(SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena), 0) AS pomer_bodu_ke_cene, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v1.body) DESC) AS rank_celkove_body, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina ORDER BY p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS predchozi_pocet_unikatnich_vykonu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = z1.typ_polozky AND v1.kod_polozky = z1.kod_polozky WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 195 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 74895 AND SUM(z1.cena) BETWEEN 281614.6 AND 3624554.87 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu_typ1, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_polozek_zup, SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp_srov, SUM(CASE WHEN p2.drg_skupina = p1.drg_skupina THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pocet_stejnych_drg_v_okoli FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.psc = p2.psc AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = 9 JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu AND z1.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p1.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p1.delka_hospitalizace > 236 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 185 AND 201 GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 35537 AND SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) < 952694.12 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_stejnych_drg_v_okoli DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 19 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 74 ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_vykonu ASC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS avg_vykon_pocet_per_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 235 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 647 ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 9 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 70 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 222 OR SUM(z.cena) > 40964.25 UNION SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.kod_polozky = 9651 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.kod_polozky = 6990 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 91 AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) < 7617 AND SUM(z.pocet) < 543.12 ORDER BY drg_skupina, delka_hospitalizace;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 257) AS count_longer_hosp_same_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 108 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 657 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8) AS cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 324 AND p.drg_skupina = 550 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4545 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 0 AND 194 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8302 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 89 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 257 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8981 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 695 UNION SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_bodu_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 38 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 39 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 99740.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) >= 721 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 346 AND v.pocet >= 72 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 7801 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS specific_procedure_count, AVG(z.cena) AS avg_zup_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY avg_zup_cost DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, COUNT(v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 215 AND v.pocet >= 60 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_hosp_days, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90d_body_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS cost_rank_per_insurer_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 123 AND (v.pocet > 61 OR z.pocet > 34.17) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5978 AND SUM(z.cena) > 1031.96 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, rolling_avg_hosp_days ASC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 290 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 9 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 5 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 232 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 958 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 47 ORDER BY rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 152 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 563 ORDER BY celkem_bodu_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 139 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 247 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 229 AND v.pocet >= 41 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pojistovny_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 111 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 2 AND v2.kod_polozky IN (8429, 2691, 5774) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 9 AND z2.cena > 86056.5 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 37 AND SUM(v.body) > 9465 AND SUM(z.cena) > 404833.9 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v WHERE v.kod_polozky = 5159 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.pocet) >= 16 ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 225 AND (p.drg_skupina = 114 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 75576.48 )) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 632 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 341 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 47 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 219 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 153 AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 25978.93 GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.pocet) > 510.06 ) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 258 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 4 AND 192 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) > 84 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'short' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS hospitalization_length_category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_count, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_days FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 340 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, hospitalization_length_category HAVING SUM(v.body) > 1309 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 5 AND p.drg_skupina = 629 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (819, 794, 718) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 46 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 64 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 7 WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 233 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND kod_polozky = 5649 AND pocet > 84) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 178 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) BETWEEN 283156.25 AND 907331.91 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_cena_ve_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 8128) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 966 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 307337.11 AND 5003400.06 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 323 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT v2.drg_skupina FROM pripady v2 WHERE v2.delka_hospitalizace > 104 AND v2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny GROUP BY v2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 71) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v3 WHERE v3.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.body > 4389) OR p.identifikace_pripadu IN (SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 21053.25 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.pocet) > 434.72) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 382 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 224 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS admission_date, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_length, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_points, SUM(SUM(z.pocet * z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_material_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 130 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (273, 749, 543) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 923459 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 598630.37 ORDER BY admission_date DESC, total_procedure_points DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(COALESCE(v.pocet * v.body, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(z.pocet * z.cena, 0)) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 41 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 65 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 289 AND 85 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 868 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 55 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_zdrave, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 899 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 1232 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 5797 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2010-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 652 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 93415 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 62 AND 141 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 10 AND 126 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 215 AND 376 THEN 'Skupina B' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS klasifikace_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 59 THEN 'Dlouhá hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 19 AND 3 THEN 'Střední hospitalizace' ELSE 'Krátká hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pojistovna_pocet_pripadu, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS celkove_body_pojistovna_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND v.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND z.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 16 AND SUM(v.body) > 21547 AND SUM(z.cena) > 541071.38 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 4 ) AS cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 213 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5657 ORDER BY celkem_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 25 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 464 AND 765 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8587 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkove_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS pozice_podle_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2702 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 512302.35 AND 328207.73 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_hospitalizace, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.datum_prijeti <= v.datum_provedeni_vykonu AND p.datum_propusteni >= v.datum_provedeni_vykonu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND p.datum_prijeti <= z.datum_provedeni_vykonu AND p.datum_propusteni >= z.datum_provedeni_vykonu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 211 AND p.drg_skupina IN (703, 796, 548) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 48449 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 242718.28 AND 837850.7 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC, p.datum_prijeti;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 72 AND p.drg_skupina = 975 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 890 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 278 AND v.body > 1608 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, COUNT(v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 43 AND v.pocet >= 33 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 216 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 97 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 95 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 216 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.kod_polozky = 3816 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 4 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS poradi_dle_bodu_v_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 263 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 3 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 266 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 95370.24 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 11 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 295 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 27 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 26 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 34 AND ( p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT kod_polozky FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 6) OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 6) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 11 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 200 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 40354.45 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 39 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 327 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 853 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 143 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > (SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01') ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 704 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS poradi_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 239 AND 113 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 298 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, poradi_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 324 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 184 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 344 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > ( SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ) ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 39 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 238 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 85 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 9 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 16 AND SUM(z.cena) < 119356.53 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 97 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 630 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 35 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 29 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 724 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 2 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 342 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (604, 886) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 54 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 68 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 38 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 262 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.body > 778 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v2.pocet) > 20 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 54 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_a_pohlavi, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 7 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vedlejsich_diagnoz FROM ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz, ',')) AS vedlejsi_diagnoza FROM pripady WHERE seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz IS NOT NULL AND seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz != '' ) AS expanded_diagnozy GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) AS diag ON p.identifikace_pripadu = diag.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 245 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (242, 885, 105) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 997 AND SUM(v.body) > 35337 AND SUM(z.cena) > 689221.47 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 58 AND 194 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_ceny_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 354 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 907 AND z.cena > 7547.67 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (184, 414, 285) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 602 AND SUM(v.body) > 545497 AND SUM(z.cena) < 815772.21 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_stejne_skupiny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 298 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 86968 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_se_stejnym_drg, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 154 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) < 58 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu_se_stejnym_drg DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 173 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) < 39 ORDER BY celkem_bodu_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_vykon_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 208 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 84395.52 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena, AVG(z.pocet) AS prumer_mnozstvi_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 222 AND p.drg_skupina IN (543, 208) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v_sub WHERE v_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v_sub.body > 192 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z_sub WHERE z_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z_sub.cena > 36564.57 ) ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 3405 OR SUM(z.cena) > 4123.22 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC NULLS LAST, pocet_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 159 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8219 OR SUM(z.cena) > 24221.46 UNION SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.drg_skupina = 988 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) < 22 ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(v.body) AS avg_vykon_body, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 7 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) AS distinct_vykon_codes_for_case, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS cost_rank_in_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 364 AND p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (876, 462, 548) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 563818.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 94 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, p.identifikace_pripadu;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS klouzavy_prumer_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 63 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 977394.2 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 25 AND p.drg_skupina IN (649, 873, 743) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 65727 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 440297.85 AND 706367.93 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 312 AND p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 911 AND SUM(z.pocet) > 774.7 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS datum_propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_po_pojistovne_drg, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '303' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_30d, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_zup_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 19 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 25 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 472 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 4789 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 310 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 24858 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 982940.68 AND 218361.53 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pozice_podle_ceny_zup_v_drg;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 92 OR p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 25 GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 51 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 72924 OR SUM(z.cena) > 60571.67 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_nakladech, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_demografii FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 25 AND z.typ_polozky = 5 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) BETWEEN 735845.93 AND 454088.54 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 240 AND (v.body > 996 OR v.body IS NULL) AND (z.cena > 23315.07 OR z.cena IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 881 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) >= 7232 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 67 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS suma_bodu_typu, COUNT(CASE WHEN z.typ_polozky = 4 THEN 1 END) AS pocet_zup_typu, SUM(CASE WHEN v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2023-12-31' THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS pocet_vykonu_obdobi, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT SUM(v2.body) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 2084)) AS max_suma_bodu_kodu_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky LEFT JOIN vykony v3 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v3.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.datum_provedeni_vykonu = (SELECT MAX(v4.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v4 WHERE v4.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu) WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'B%') AND p.psc IN (SELECT p2.psc FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny GROUP BY p2.psc HAVING COUNT(*) > 817) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 879 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) BETWEEN 757262.83 AND 8931639.72 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_delka_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX(sub.max_body_za_den) AS maximalni_denni_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN ( SELECT v_inner.identifikace_pripadu, v_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(v_inner.body) AS max_body_za_den FROM vykony v_inner WHERE v_inner.kod_polozky >= 8043 GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu, v_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu ORDER BY SUM(v_inner.body) DESC LIMIT 1000 OFFSET 50 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 919 AND 807 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z_exists WHERE z_exists.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z_exists.kod_polozky = 5284 AND z_exists.cena > 5459.39 AND z_exists.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 776 AND SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(z.cena), 0) < 1.26 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky AS typ_vykonu, z.typ_polozky AS typ_zup, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 208 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND v.body > 1140 AND z.cena > 55779.99 GROUP BY CUBE( p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 870 AND SUM(z.cena) > 512373.97 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;
