SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 314 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 81405.75 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 40 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 42 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT v2.drg_skupina FROM pripady v2 WHERE v2.delka_hospitalizace > 247 AND v2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny GROUP BY v2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 759) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v3 WHERE v3.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.body > 7300) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 393575 AND SUM(z.cena) > 380296.59 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS prijeti_rok, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS prijeti_kvartal, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS prumerna_denni_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_v_roce FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 3 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 720 AND 423 AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 15 AND v.body > 221 AND z.cena > 240.21 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 166 AND SUM(z.cena) > 745797.35 ORDER BY prijeti_rok DESC, prijeti_kvartal DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 39 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 13 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p2.delka_hospitalizace > 127 AND v2.kod_polozky = 2302 AND p2.vekovy_interval_pacienta = '0-9' GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikator_pacienta) > 259 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 461759 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) BETWEEN 55516.37 AND 503452.72 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) AS percentile_75_vykon_body, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) AS percentile_90_zup_cena, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS kumulativni_body_po_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 351 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 805 AND SUM(z.cena) < 569248.9 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.datum_prijeti, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 303 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.datum_prijeti ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, p.datum_prijeti;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 269 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) < 2376 OR SUM(v.body) IS NULL ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkem_bodu ASC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, AVG(z.cena) AS avg_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 29 AND p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace < 206 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 591 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 97 AND p.drg_skupina = 411 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 804 ORDER BY cost_rank;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalizace, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 17) AS distinct_vykon_kody, (SELECT SUM(z2.pocet) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 46 AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AS filtered_zup_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 822 LEFT JOIN vykony v3 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v3.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.kod_polozky = 6534 LEFT JOIN zup z4 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z4.identifikace_pripadu AND z4.kod_polozky = 5255 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 203 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.body > 292 OR z.pocet > 91.84) AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta IN ('0-18', '0-18') GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 83 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 63 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, avg_hospitalizace ASC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 5 AND 65 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2933 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 286 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 5219.32 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 462633 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti) AS prum_delka_hosp_pojist_drg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 93 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4965 AND SUM(z.cena) > 73448.35 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_pocet, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_polozky_pocet, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.body IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_90_body_vykonu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.cena IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_75_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 35 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 26 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 121 AND 505 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-12-31') GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 596 AND SUM(z.cena) < 79418.71 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_pocet, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_polozky_pocet, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.body IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_90_body_vykonu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.cena IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_75_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 57 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 3 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 209 AND 624 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-12-31') GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 595 AND SUM(z.cena) < 514459.92 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 241 AND v.pocet >= 34 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(v.body) AS prumer_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 149 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 1382 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, rank_v_drg;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumer_vykonu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 136 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8662 ORDER BY celkem_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 130 AND 238 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 6 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC NULLS LAST, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 199 AND v.body > 6040 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6) AS pocet_jedinecnych_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 66 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 49 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10) AS avg_zup_price FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 26 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 113 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 3630 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 1 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(v.body) AS avg_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS body_rank_by_gender FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 264 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2333 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 257 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (383) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 966 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 858.43 GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.pocet) > 45.68 ) AND v.body > 393 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.pocet) >= 25 ) AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 217 AND 186 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 94 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 919 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) < ( SELECT AVG(body_sum) * 1.5 FROM ( SELECT SUM(v_inner.body) AS body_sum FROM vykony v_inner WHERE v_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu ) avg_calc ) ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 264 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 325 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky IN (SELECT typ_polozky FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky = 9460) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 722 ORDER BY celkem_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 119 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta = ( SELECT MAX(p2.vekovy_interval_pacienta) FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.pohlavi_pacienta = p.pohlavi_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 27 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 336 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 44 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 59 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 335 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 268 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 912 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_cases, AVG(v.body) AS avg_procedure_points FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 912 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 97 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 2 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS specific_type_points FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 74 AND 23 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 279 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 29 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 267 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 563 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT p_inner.identifikace_pripadu FROM pripady p_inner WHERE p_inner.drg_skupina = 873 AND p_inner.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 110 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 167 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 9713 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 12 AND 137 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 33 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 304 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 219 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 48 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 330 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 26 AND p.drg_skupina = 139) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace <= 4 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (1, 9)) ) AND NOT (p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta = '0-18') AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 100 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady_zup, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka) FROM (SELECT delka_hospitalizace AS delka FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina) AS sub) AS prum_delka_skupina FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 167 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 990 ORDER BY celkem_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady_zup, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka) FROM (SELECT delka_hospitalizace AS delka FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina) AS sub) AS prum_delka_skupina FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 234 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 975 ORDER BY celkem_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 270 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 264554.7 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 353 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 8410 AND z.cena > 55418.89 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (606, 226, 662) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 96 AND SUM(z.cena) < 208445.53 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(v.body) AS prumerne_body, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_dle_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 235 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 426766.5 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_dle_bodu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 229 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS distinct_pripady, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 116 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 956 ORDER BY distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 88 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 48489.92 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 84 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 1 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 23 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 363 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 3 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 397 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 37 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS total_vykon_points, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_vykon_points, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_cases FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 172 AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (538, 467, 167) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 256908.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 372 ORDER BY total_zup_cost DESC, propusteni_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_a_roce, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 11 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 68 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 325 AND v.body > 1275 AND z.cena > 34779.8 AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 112 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 71) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 437155 AND SUM(z.cena) > 7035426.64 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkova_hodnota DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prum_bodu_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu_v_skupine, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vykonu_datum FROM vykony WHERE datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) vykony_sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = vykony_sub.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, SUM(cena) AS celkem_cena_zup_datum FROM zup WHERE datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) zup_sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = zup_sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 310 AND 126 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (305, 153, 866) AND (vykony_sub.pocet_vykonu_datum > 57 OR vykony_sub.pocet_vykonu_datum IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 627 AND SUM(v.body) > 196828 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) < 70 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 164 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 614 AND SUM(z.cena) > 765045.01 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 53) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_dle_pojistovny_drg, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_vek_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.datum_prijeti <= v.datum_provedeni_vykonu AND p.datum_propusteni >= v.datum_provedeni_vykonu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu = z.datum_provedeni_vykonu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 289 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 5258 AND z.cena > 77482.89 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 399 AND SUM(z.cena) < 9324534.68 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_dle_pojistovny_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_zdravo_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 302 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 905 AND SUM(z.cena) < 247450.24 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_po_pojistovne_a_pohlavi FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 42 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (810, 697, 993) AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 376 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 5527 AND (SUM(v.body) > 842947 OR SUM(z.cena) > 125861.0) ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 135 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (770, 518, 789) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 942 AND SUM(v.body) > 43786 AND SUM(z.cena) > 328102.51 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_po_skupine ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumerna_celkova_body_po_pojistovne_a_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 277 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 7611 AND z.cena > 30366.71 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 800 AND SUM(v.body) > 613329 AND SUM(z.cena) > 5633938.98 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_po_skupine ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS kumulativni_body_po_pojistovne FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 22 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 79 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 90 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 890 AND SUM(v.body) > 167520 AND SUM(z.cena) > 4969131.72 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS distinct_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_delka_hospitalizace, MAX(CAST(p.datum_propusteni AS DATE) - CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE)) AS max_dni_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 157 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 232 AND z.cena > 76893.58 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 975 AND SUM(z.cena) > 613199.54 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) AS diagnoza_kapitola, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prum_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prum_cena_na_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 93 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE '%I10%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni AND v.body > 719 AND z.cena > 9983.53 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 66 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 38 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkem_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z1.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace_srovnatelnych_pripadu, SUM(SUM(v1.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS kumulativni_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta = p2.vekovy_interval_pacienta AND p1.pohlavi_pacienta = p2.pohlavi_pacienta JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = v2.typ_polozky WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 70 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p1.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 1597 AND SUM(z1.cena) BETWEEN 769898.23 AND 314191.02 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_p1, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body_p1, COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_p2, SUM(v2.body) AS celkove_body_p2, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_p1, SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup_p1, COUNT(DISTINCT z2.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_p2, SUM(z2.cena * z2.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup_p2, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(v1.body) + SUM(v2.body) DESC) AS rank_celkovych_bodu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.pohlavi_pacienta = p2.pohlavi_pacienta AND p1.identifikace_pripadu < p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 234 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 145 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, p1.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 10598 AND SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) > 112160.62 ORDER BY rank_celkovych_bodu;

SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 115 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY celkem_bodu_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prumer_bodu_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 188 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5847 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_body_by_drg_length FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 176 AND v.body > 658 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4361 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS klouzavy_prumer_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 10 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 51379.7 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 11 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 389 AND 177 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 127 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'krátká' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'střední' ELSE 'dlouhá' END AS kategorie_delky_hospitalizace, AVG(v.body) AS prumerne_body_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 242 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 11603.89 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 465 AND 462 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING SUM(v.body) > 646 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 71 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 144 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 15719 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 50664.19 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 63 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 83 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 247 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 18727 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 464963.69 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 153 AND v.pocet >= 48 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1) AS pocet_jedinecnych_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 23 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 13 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, (SELECT SUM(v.body) FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 256 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 68 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 131 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 31 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4426 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 9 AND 64 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 363 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_naklady FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 258 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 61 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 294 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 284 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 85 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 102 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 662 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS celkove_poradi_hodnoty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS poradi_v_pojistovne FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 31 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 1022 AND z.cena > 32267.91 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 322 AND SUM(v.body) > 123846 AND SUM(z.cena) > 5301948.3 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 92 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_polozek, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 4) AS max_body_vykonu_v_pripadu, (SELECT AVG(sub_z.cena) FROM zup sub_z WHERE sub_z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_z.typ_polozky = 3 GROUP BY sub_z.identifikace_pripadu) AS prumerna_cena_zup_v_pripadu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_dle_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 137 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) > 784 OR COUNT(z.kod_polozky) > 621 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 97 ) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu_pro_pripad, (SELECT SUM(z2.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z2.pocet), 0) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 70 AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= p.datum_prijeti ) AS prumerna_cena_zup_pro_typ FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN p.datum_prijeti AND p.datum_propusteni WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 327 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 838 AND z.cena > 94823.48 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu, p.datum_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 7 AND AVG(z.cena) < 21665.35 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup, MAX(v.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS posledni_datum_vykonu, MAX(z.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS posledni_datum_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS dense_rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 339 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 8278 AND z.cena > 26779.88 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 363 AND SUM(v.body) > 417022 AND SUM(z.cena) > 549962.41 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC LIMIT 585;
