SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS pocet_unikatnich_pacientu, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pohybujici_soucet_bodu_30_dni, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pohybujici_prumer_nakladu_7_dni FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 3 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 5712 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 1785 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 148 AND 55 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 476180.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 39 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sub_p.identifikator_pacienta) FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND sub_p.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina) AS pocet_unikatnich_pacientu_pojistovna_drg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hosp_pojistovna, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace)) AS percent_rank_prum_delka_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 240 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.drg_skupina IN (548, 660, 700) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 428 AND SUM(v.body) > 54104 AND SUM(z.cena) > 767486.74 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 7505 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS specific_procedure_count, AVG(z.cena) AS avg_zup_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 974 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 842 ORDER BY v2.body DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 61 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 16 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 167 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 72 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 9 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 4 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 135 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.kod_polozky = 7825 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v2.body) > 8109 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 823 AND SUM(z.cena) < 172948.54 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.body), 0) AS cena_na_bod, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 33 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 16 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 6121) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 380 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 27 AND SUM(v.body) > 86316 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_zdrave, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 41 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 6499 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 2606 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 269 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2010-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 105 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 7960 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 3 AND 135 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS cena_na_den_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 64 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 8 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 7998 AND z.cena > 85486.41 AND p.psc IN (SELECT psc FROM pripady WHERE psc LIKE '1%' GROUP BY psc HAVING COUNT(*) > 433) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 568 AND SUM(z.cena) > 209316.03 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 87 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pozice_podle_ceny_v_skupine;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS body_na_den_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina > 482 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 122 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 421 AND SUM(z.cena) > 83379.88 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 87 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (860, 126, 866) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 31604 AND SUM(z.cena) < 797664.34 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AS pojistovna, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(*) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkem_dnu FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 146 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AS pojistovna, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(*) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE v.pocet > 61 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY pojistovna, drg_skupina;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2018-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 263 AND 132 AND v.body > 711 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 45 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 235 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 515 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 40 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 653 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 223 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 811 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 137 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 724 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 352 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE v.pocet > 19 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'Z' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_cases, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_stay FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 851 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 68 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_patients, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedure_codes, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 94 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 70522 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 223 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 639 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 550 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 176 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 98 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 164 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 126 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 106 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 566 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 151 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_naklady_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 998249.12 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.identifikace_pripadu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.kod_polozky = 2809 AND v2.typ_polozky = 7) AS pocet_pripadu_s_vykonem, (SELECT AVG(z2.cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.kod_polozky = 1185 AND z2.typ_polozky = 10) AS prumerna_cena_zup_polozky FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 0 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 186 AND SUM(v.body) > 23765 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 62) AS pocet_unikatnich_kodu_vykonu, (SELECT SUM(z2.cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AS cena_zup_od_data FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 32 AND SUM(v.body) >= 99465 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 183 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v2.body) AS sum_body FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.typ_polozky = 66 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu ORDER BY sum_body DESC LIMIT 808 OFFSET 780 ) AS top_vykony WHERE top_vykony.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu ) AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 11986.0 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.pocet) >= 88.81 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 543 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 115 AND p.drg_skupina IN (472, 925, 156) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 951 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 142 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 570 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, rank_v_skupine;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 27 AND v.body > 911 AND z.cena > 91631.96 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 939 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 2735686.18 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS grouping_id, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 13 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) HAVING COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) > 293 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 76 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 265 AND 295 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 56 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING SUM(body) > 686805 ORDER BY SUM(body) DESC LIMIT 87 OFFSET 95 ) ) AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN ( SELECT identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT drg_skupina) >= 10 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 746 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 80 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 1 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.body > 343 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v2.pocet) > 32 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 222 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p.identifikace_pripadu <> p2.identifikace_pripadu INNER JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 339 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01') AND p2.delka_hospitalizace < 274 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 810 AND SUM(v.body) > 994171 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC NULLS LAST, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_ve_skupine, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS kumulativni_pripady_pojistovny, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumerna_cena_zup_ve_skupine_a_intervalu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 11 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 5 AND z.typ_polozky = 1 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 327397 AND SUM(z.cena) > 581615.8 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_celkove_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_cena_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 163 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 2815 AND z.cena > 63410.24 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 770 AND SUM(v.body) > 13505 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3612523.52 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agr.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agr.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agr.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agr.celkem_body), 0)) AS cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agr ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agr.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena, COUNT(*) AS pocet_polozek FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agr ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agr.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (755) AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 107 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 583 AND SUM(v_agr.celkem_body) > 3912 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS avg_hosp_length, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_30day_body_sum FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 27 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 589 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 191 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 125701 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3550176.82 ORDER BY total_vykon_body DESC, prijeti_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 40 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 37 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 AND (v.body > 3123 OR v.body IS NULL) AND (z.cena > 65115.22 OR z.cena IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 621 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 2630 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, celkova_hodnota DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) AS diag_prefix, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, SUM(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_delka_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 103 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') AND p.psc LIKE '1' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 922 AND SUM(v.body) > 35152 AND SUM(z.cena) > 437937.78 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(*) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v WHERE v.kod_polozky = 9323 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 178 ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 281 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 88 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 23035.1 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 8 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 155 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 5414 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.cena > 95305.69 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 189 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 357 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 29050.78 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 226980 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 358 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 26893.02 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 53 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 178 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 78 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 506.63 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 66 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 502 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 127 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 313 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 1627 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS specific_procedure_count, AVG(z.cena) AS avg_zup_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 134 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2018-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 223 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 23 AND p.drg_skupina = 799) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace <= 2 AND p.drg_skupina != 514) ) AND NOT (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 10) AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 20 AND SUM(z.cena) < 487405.95 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6 WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 48 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND kod_polozky = 1524 AND pocet > 11) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 987 AND SUM(z.cena) < 381158.36 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 82 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pripady_dlouhe_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 5470 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.kod_polozky = 4952 THEN z.pocet * z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 86 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 297 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 72 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 375 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospital_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_days, COUNT(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS distinct_primary_diagnoses, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_item_count, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_by_days_per_insurer_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_quarter_cases FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 241 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2010-01-01' AND v.body > 8244 AND z.cena > 2804.54 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 150868 AND SUM(z.cena) > 415013.01 ORDER BY total_hospital_days DESC, admission_year, admission_quarter;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 82) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 42) AS pocet_zup_typu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 755 AND SUM(v.body) > 783510 AND SUM(z.cena) > 7272609.71 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, MAX(sub.max_cena_na_vykon) AS max_cena_na_vykon FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky JOIN ( SELECT v_inner.identifikace_pripadu, v_inner.typ_polozky, v_inner.kod_polozky, MAX(z_inner.cena / NULLIF(v_inner.pocet, 0)) AS max_cena_na_vykon FROM vykony v_inner JOIN zup z_inner ON v_inner.identifikace_pripadu = z_inner.identifikace_pripadu AND v_inner.typ_polozky = z_inner.typ_polozky AND v_inner.kod_polozky = z_inner.kod_polozky WHERE v_inner.pocet > 54 AND z_inner.cena > 1084.13 GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu, v_inner.typ_polozky, v_inner.kod_polozky HAVING MAX(z_inner.cena / NULLIF(v_inner.pocet, 0)) > 2556.4 ) sub ON v.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = sub.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = sub.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND p.drg_skupina IN (936, 286, 229) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 659 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_zup_naklady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 62) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 79) AS pocet_zup_typu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS rank_naklady, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 39 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 2 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 230 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 997559.48 ORDER BY celkem_zup_naklady DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 4 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 131 AND 155 AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT DISTINCT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky = 7920 AND datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(pocet) > 58 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 359 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 95 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3), ', ' ORDER BY SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3)) AS skupiny_diagnoz, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 3) AS pocet_ruzných_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.body), 0) AS prum_cena_na_bod FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 249 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 903 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 41 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet * v.body), 0) AS pomer_cena_na_bod, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 305 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 835 AND z.cena > 58674.7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 275 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 864615 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 4116866.19 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesic_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_zup_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace >= 327 AND v.body > 191 AND z.cena > 1223.3 AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NOT IN (0, 6) OR p.drg_skupina IN (539, 521, 553)) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 39 AND SUM(v.body) > 55327 AND SUM(z.cena) > 405049.78 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, mesic_prijeti DESC, celkem_zup_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) AS diagnoza_kapitola, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 319 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE '%B%') AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.psc IN (SELECT psc FROM pripady WHERE vekovy_interval_pacienta = '0-18' GROUP BY psc HAVING COUNT(*) > 702) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 96189 AND AVG(z.cena) BETWEEN 2904.33 AND 3973.2 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_stejne_skupiny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 215 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 94338 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace_sdruzenych_pripadu, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) / NULLIF(SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena), 0) AS pomer_bodu_ke_cene, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v1.body) DESC) AS rank_celkove_body, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina ORDER BY p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS predchozi_pocet_unikatnich_vykonu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = z1.typ_polozky AND v1.kod_polozky = z1.kod_polozky WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 116 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 3659 AND SUM(z1.cena) BETWEEN 527500.78 AND 6916797.61 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_procedures FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 62 AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 871 ORDER BY propusteni_date DESC, total_procedures DESC;
