SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.body > 654 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v2.pocet) > 8 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 42 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 717960 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 35953.95 SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 217717.87 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, rok_prijeti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky) AS grouping_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 23 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 41 GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8357 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_se_stejnym_drg, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 97 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) < 93 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu_se_stejnym_drg DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_skupina, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykony, AVG(z1.cena / NULLIF(z1.pocet, 0)) AS prumerna_jednotkova_cena_zup, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_stejna_pojistovna_drg, SUM(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS soucet_delky_hosp_stejna_pojistovna_drg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) DESC) AS pozice_podle_bodu_v_skupine FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 338 AND p1.delka_hospitalizace < 329 AND v1.body > 289 AND z1.cena > 75512.08 AND (p1.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' OR p1.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01') GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) > 559514 AND AVG(z1.cena / NULLIF(z1.pocet, 0)) < 2456.99 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykony DESC, prumerna_jednotkova_cena_zup ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 336 AND p1.drg_skupina = 137 GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) < 39 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cena, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_body_30d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 29 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 35138.3 ORDER BY total_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 85 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 30745.8 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 44 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 196 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 11 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 123 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 962 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 196 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 94 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS diagnozy, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 4 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) > 496 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 283 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 274 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupine, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS celkove_poradi_delky FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 236 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 9581 AND z.cena > 942040.83 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 652 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 4459 AND SUM(z.cena) > 6436952.2 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 97 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 64 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 50 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 1471 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 9895 AND z2.cena > 80156.13 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 894 AND SUM(v.body) >= 770977 AND SUM(z.cena) <= 6383962.79 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS pocet_unikatnich_pacientu, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pohybujici_soucet_bodu_30_dni, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pohybujici_prumer_cen_7_dni FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 9 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 179 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 28295 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace >= 124 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 53169 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) < 882 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_uhrada_odhad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 55 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 98 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 9 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 8249) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 196 AND SUM(v.body) > 605539 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 317 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE v.pocet > 37 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 227 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 667 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 322 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 941 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesic_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_po_pojistovne_a_roce FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 352 AND v.body > 955 AND z.cena > 12439.14 AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NOT IN (0, 6) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 914 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 8071977.5 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, mesic_prijeti ASC, celkove_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_polozek, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine, LAG(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_celkova_delka FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 33 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 41 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 196 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 156 AND (SUM(v.body) > 81616 OR SUM(z.cena) > 621647.56) ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 263 AND p.drg_skupina = 633 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 339 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 208 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 6 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 42337.05 AND 76162.74;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 41 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 20775.03 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 925637 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 78 AND p.drg_skupina IN (107, 473, 241) AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= SUM(z.cena) > 58157.72 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalizace, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 300 AND p.drg_skupina IN (464, 608, 597) AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 6 AND z.typ_polozky = 8 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 118 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 52 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 258 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 288 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, COUNT(v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 257 AND v.pocet >= 15 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 33 AND p.drg_skupina IN (410, 11, 439) AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 859 AND 640 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 60 AND SUM(z.cena) > 98148.13 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(v.pocet) AS avg_pocet_vykon, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 7367.73) AS pocet_drahych_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 7151 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 98 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 32412.7 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 480 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 286 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 62 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 357 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (424) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 60 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS pocet_pacientu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 46 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 35 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS diagnozy, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 182 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 34 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 163 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 658 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 100 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 346 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, (SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet * v.body), 0)) AS naklady_na_bod FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 250 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 9439 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 453638.53 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 45 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 996 AND z.cena > 6149.33 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 826 AND SUM(z.cena) > 403302.85 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_polozek, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS body_na_den, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS cena_zup_na_den, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (115, 87, 812) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 102814 AND SUM(z.cena) > 813573.12 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykony, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_naklady_zup, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupinach, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_nakladu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 177 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 51870 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 291085.91 ORDER BY celkem_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, ( SELECT SUM(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 4 AND sub_v.kod_polozky >= 1468 AND sub_v.kod_polozky <= 3356 ) AS body_vykonu_pro_typ, ( SELECT SUM(sub_z.cena) FROM zup sub_z WHERE sub_z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_z.typ_polozky = 8 AND sub_z.kod_polozky >= 5520 AND sub_z.kod_polozky <= 9813 ) AS cena_zup_pro_typ FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 144 AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 604 AND 800 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 36 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 22 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 80)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 3 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > (SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND pohlavi_pacienta = p.pohlavi_pacienta) AND SUM(v.body) > 358832 AND SUM(z.cena) > 9646073.39 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 147 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 9658 AND z.cena > 18053.15 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 846 AND SUM(v.body) > 14100 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3925234.54 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) AS percentile_75_vykon_body, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) AS percentile_90_zup_cena, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 176 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 923 AND SUM(z.cena) < 36923.28 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 100 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 17061.69 LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 137 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 307 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 63814.78 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 783 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 271 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 17383.66 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 495238.94 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 220 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 17155.18 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 471 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 302 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 444 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND kod_polozky = 8446 AND pocet > 22) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 102 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) BETWEEN 644843.93 AND 271130.11 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 INNER JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 318 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 310 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 100 AND 199 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'Skupina B' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN 'Skupina C' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS kategorie_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 THEN 'Dlouhá hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Střední hospitalizace' ELSE 'Krátká hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 40 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, kategorie_drg, kategorie_delky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 288 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS distinct_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cena, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_by_cena, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prev_pripady_in_group FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 278 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 782 AND z.cena > 42711.34 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 506 AND SUM(z.cena) > 458967.66 ORDER BY total_cena DESC, distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 78 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 328 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pocet_pripadu_predchozi_ctvrleti FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 7 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 20 AND v.body > 755 AND z.cena > 49366.16 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2010, 2013, 2011) AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 3 AND 3 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 908 AND SUM(z.cena) < 9797360.22 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti ASC, celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet * v.body), 0) AS naklady_na_bod, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 245 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND v.body > 844 AND z.cena > 97755.95 AND p.psc IN (SELECT psc FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny GROUP BY psc HAVING COUNT(*) > 4) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 191 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) < 283854 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) BETWEEN 676847.51 AND 162914.15 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, rank_delka_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_zakladnich_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 163 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 580 AND SUM(v.body) > 434237 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3297445.31 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_po_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu_dle_skupiny, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 17 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 14 WHERE (p.delka_hospitalizace > 221 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01') OR (p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p2.delka_hospitalizace < 0)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 9618 AND v2.pocet > 8)) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 333709 OR SUM(z.cena) < 115505.5 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 285 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 82) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 92) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 162 AND 12 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) < 191 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5297 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 13 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 448 AND z.cena > 16655.19 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 952 AND SUM(v.body) > 707835 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3217679.76 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 76 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 24 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 42 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 507 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 37) AS max_body_vykonu_pro_typ, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 13 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (941, 148, 389) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 20 AND SUM(z.cena) < 529348.36 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS prumerna_cena_za_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 205 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (680, 571, 400) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 765 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 55605 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, MAX(CAST(p.datum_propusteni AS DATE)) - MIN(CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE)) AS analyzovane_obdobi_dni FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 183 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 172 AND z.cena > 62764.7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 135 AND SUM(z.cena) > 205762.23 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;
