SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2021-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 76 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS diagnozy, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 292 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) > 543 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 171 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM zup WHERE cena > 87749.28 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT identifikace_pripadu) > 655 ) GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(body) > 97775 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 642 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_ve_skupine, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 36 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 35 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 104) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 8019 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 9351 AND z2.cena > 18533.32) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 259662 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 48323.08 AND 117321.46 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_vekovem_intervalu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 48 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 60 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_jedinecnych_diagnoz FROM ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, zakladni_diagnoza FROM pripady UNION SELECT identifikace_pripadu, UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz, ',')) AS diagnoza FROM pripady WHERE seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz IS NOT NULL ) AS vsechny_diagnozy GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) d ON p.identifikace_pripadu = d.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 30 AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 8933 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 64986.54 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 836994 AND SUM(z.cena) < 74070.38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 9 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_cena_ve_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 222 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 5834) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 544 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 631961.97 AND 2877937.86 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 32 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 34 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 54 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 886 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 17 OFFSET 79) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 4494 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LIMIT 4 OFFSET 2) AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 18 AND 197 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 697769 AND SUM(z.cena) > 8901081.71 ORDER BY celkem_body_vykonu DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 81 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 717 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 338 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 906 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC, celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS celkem_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 139 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pripady_dlouhe_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 1034 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS pocet_konkretniho_vykonu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.kod_polozky = 8499 THEN z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS cena_konkretniho_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' THEN p.zakladni_diagnoza END) AS pocet_odlisnych_diagnoz, SUM(CASE WHEN TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pripady_v_obdobi FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 9 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL AND p.datum_prijeti IS NOT NULL AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$') AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$') AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 2 AND 49 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 413 AND SUM(v.body) > 47229 AND SUM(z.cena) > 822374.1 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_ve_skupine, LAG(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_celkova_delka FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 17 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 779 AND SUM(v.body) > 12457 AND SUM(z.cena) > 344935.87 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_po_pojistovne_a_pohlavi, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumerna_celkova_body_vykonu_ve_skupine_a_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND v.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND z.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p.identifikace_pripadu <> p2.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikator_pacienta IS NOT NULL AND p2.identifikator_pacienta IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND p2.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND v2.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 20 AND p.drg_skupina IN (779, 552, 777) AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 204 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 786478.61 AND 988334.95 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_zakladnich_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 296 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 634 AND SUM(v.body) > 565166 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3813406.81 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_po_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_dle_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 28 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 63 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vykonu FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky = 5643 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, SUM(cena) AS celkem_cena_specificka FROM zup WHERE kod_polozky = 9883 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 279 AND p.drg_skupina IN (599, 943, 731) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 73543 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 572788.68 AND 321110.85 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 150 AND p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 865 AND SUM(z.pocet) > 956.82 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti) AS prum_delka_hosp_pojist_drg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 196 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 7660 AND SUM(z.cena) > 55017.11 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_po_pojistovne_drg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS celkove_cenove_poradi, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS poradi_dle_bodu_v_ramci_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 2 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 184 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 347817.94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 73 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cena, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_body_30d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 316 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 91227.24 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS body_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 60 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 732 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, body_rank;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 6) AS total_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 169 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2062 ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(v.body) AS avg_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS body_rank_by_gender FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 132 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5520 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 246 AND v.pocet >= 56 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.delka_hospitalizace > 221 ) AND v.pocet > 17 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 318 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 8615 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 13 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 820 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > ( SELECT AVG(body_sum) FROM ( SELECT SUM(v_inner.body) AS body_sum FROM vykony v_inner WHERE v_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu ) AS avg_sub ) ) AS sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 127 AND 227 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 318 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 85 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 351 AND p.drg_skupina = 365 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 3 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 86 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 11 AND SUM(z.cena) < 534638.52 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 5 AND p.drg_skupina = 660 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 687 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 105 AND v.pocet >= 84 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'Krátká' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 30 THEN 'Střední' ELSE 'Dlouhá' END AS kategorie_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(v.body) AS prumerne_body_vykonu, MAX(z.pocet) AS maximalni_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 81 AND v.body > 386 AND z.cena > 90643.57 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, kategorie_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 677 AND SUM(z.cena) > 317077.18 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, (SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0)) AS prum_naklady_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 280 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v2.body) AS sum_body_sub FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu ORDER BY sum_body_sub DESC LIMIT 3134 OFFSET 249 ) AS top_vykony WHERE top_vykony.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 962 ORDER BY prum_naklady_na_pripad DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 79 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 449 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 320 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 602 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 2 INNER JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 290 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 115 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 244 OR p.drg_skupina IN (930, 973, 482) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 5932 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) OR p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 14982.77 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.pocet) > 71.11 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 774 AND SUM(v.body) < 750189 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_po_bodech FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 179 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 325 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, rank_po_bodech;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 253 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 350 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 788 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS distinct_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, MAX(CAST(v.datum_provedeni_vykonu AS DATE)) AS posledni_vykon, MIN(CAST(z.datum_provedeni_vykonu AS DATE)) AS prvni_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 275 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 770 AND z.cena > 58473.7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 207 AND SUM(z.cena) > 21106.21 ORDER BY total_cena DESC, distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_days, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS avg_cost_per_case FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years') AND (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '200 days') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 44 AND z.cena > 6723.01 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 46480.08 ORDER BY total_zup_cost DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS grouping_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 299 GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 982 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'Short Stay' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'Medium Stay' ELSE 'Long Stay' END AS stay_category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospital_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_days, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedure_codes, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_material_codes, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_material_quantity, SUM(z.cena) AS total_material_cost, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_value, MAX(v.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS latest_procedure_date, MIN(z.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS earliest_material_date FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 271 AND v.body > 458 AND z.cena > 1257.5 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'Short Stay' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'Medium Stay' ELSE 'Long Stay' END HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 62 AND SUM(z.cena) > 470550.89 ORDER BY total_material_cost DESC, total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'Short Stay' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'Medium Stay' ELSE 'Long Stay' END AS stay_category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospital_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_days, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedure_codes, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_material_codes, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_material_quantity, SUM(z.cena) AS total_material_cost, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_value, MAX(v.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS latest_procedure_date, MIN(z.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS earliest_material_date FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 280 AND v.body > 907 AND z.cena > 2091.78 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'Short Stay' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'Medium Stay' ELSE 'Long Stay' END HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 722 AND SUM(z.cena) > 474352.69 ORDER BY total_material_cost DESC, total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, (SUM(v.pocet * v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0)) AS body_na_den, (SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0)) AS prumerny_naklad_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 278 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 749 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 1089 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 537793 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 4197009.24 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.identifikace_pripadu) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS body_na_den, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS zup_cena_rank FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 273 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 127 AND SUM(z.cena) > 301408.65 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sub_p.identifikace_pripadu) FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND sub_p.delka_hospitalizace > 233) AS celkovy_pocet_pripadu_drg_nad_limit, (SELECT AVG(sub_agg.prumerna_cena) FROM (SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z2.cena)/NULLIF(SUM(z2.pocet),0) AS prumerna_cena FROM zup z2 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.cena) > 583816.19) sub_agg) AS prumerna_cena_na_jednotku_pro_nakladne_pripady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_v_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 11 AND 301 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 252 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 7451 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(v_max.max_body_den) AS maximalni_body_za_den, MIN(v_min.min_body_den) AS minimalni_body_za_den, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS dense_rank_pripady_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 27 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 87 JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS max_body_den FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 27 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_max ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_max.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS min_body_den FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 31 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_min ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_min.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 284 AND p.delka_hospitalizace < 267 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 6583 AND z.cena > 82149.42 AND z.pocet > 351.6 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') AND p.psc IN ('10000', '10000', '10000') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 378 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5471 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 40 AND 70 AND SUM(v.body) > 34734 AND SUM(z.cena) > 295410.59 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 258 AND (v.body > 360 OR v.body IS NULL) AND (z.cena > 63211.48 OR z.cena IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 78 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) >= 4783 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkove_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_podle_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 162 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 81 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (616, 397, 906) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 457 AND SUM(z.cena) > 2117.84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_delka_drg_vek;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(sub.total_body_per_case) AS sum_total_body_per_case, AVG(sub.total_body_per_case) AS avg_total_body_per_case, MAX(sub.max_body_single_procedure) AS max_body_single_procedure, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_by_vykon_body, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS dense_rank_in_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT v_inner.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v_inner.body) AS total_body_per_case, MAX(v_inner.body) AS max_body_single_procedure FROM vykony v_inner WHERE v_inner.body > 8532 GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v_inner.body) > 55973 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 280 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 990 AND SUM(v.body) > 767924 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prev_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 153 OR p.drg_skupina IN (75, 61, 728) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 4756 AND v2.typ_polozky = 1 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.cena > 79733.4 AND z2.typ_polozky = 10 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 342 AND SUM(v.body) > 466615 AND SUM(z.cena) > 4994428.18 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC LIMIT 628;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agr.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agr.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agr.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agr.celkem_body), 0)) AS cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agr ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agr.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena, COUNT(*) AS pocet_polozek FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agr ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agr.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (707) AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 188 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 459 AND SUM(v_agr.celkem_body) > 1899 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 193 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 114770 INTERSECT SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 23 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 3577643.39 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_dle_bodu_v_drg_a_veku, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_po_pojistovne_drg_a_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND p.drg_skupina IN (693, 457, 254) AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 850 AND SUM(z.cena) > 636282.57 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, rank_dle_bodu_v_drg_a_veku;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(v_max.max_body_za_den) AS maximalni_body_za_den_pripadu, MIN(v_min.min_body_za_den) AS minimalni_body_za_den_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS max_body_za_den FROM vykony WHERE body > 519 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_max ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_max.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS min_body_za_den FROM vykony WHERE body < 4673 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_min ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_min.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 79 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.drg_skupina IN (98, 124, 260) AND v.typ_polozky = 2 AND z.typ_polozky = 3 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 21 AND SUM(v.body) > 8963 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 701767.04 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_skupina FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 341 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 6001 AND z.cena > 78335.09 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 928 AND SUM(z.cena) > 724531.45 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rok_prijeti ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky AS typ_vykonu, z.typ_polozky AS typ_zup, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 309 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND v.body > 539 AND z.cena > 1508.73 GROUP BY CUBE( p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 668 AND SUM(z.cena) > 442964.12 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 754 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) < 45509 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 258 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 53 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 157 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 59470.68 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 14 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 313 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 16273.08 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 34932 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 207 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 893 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 219 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 881 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 512 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(pocet) > 65 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 788 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 187 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (300, 770, 54) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 661 AND SUM(v.pocet) < 87798 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.delka_hospitalizace > 49 AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' ) AND v.body > 8216 AND z.cena > 24056.38 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 345 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_a_roce, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 25 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 71 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2010-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 AND v.body > 7045 AND z.cena > 87665.63 AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 297 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 189) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 215462 AND SUM(z.cena) > 5919245.83 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, ctvrleti_prijeti DESC, celkova_hodnota DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 1) AS pocet_vykonu_typ1, SUM(v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 2) AS celkove_body_typ2, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 100 AND 199 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'Skupina B' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN 'Skupina C' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS drg_kategorie, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) THEN 'Nadprůměrná' ELSE 'Průměrná nebo podprůměrná' END AS delka_vs_prumer_drg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_celkova_delka, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 100 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (658, 946, 535) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 455 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 658478.89 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 68 AND 196 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 235 AND 354 THEN 'Skupina B' ELSE 'Ostatni skupiny' END AS klasifikace_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 134 THEN 'Dlouha hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 1 THEN 'Stredni hospitalizace' ELSE 'Kratka hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 9 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.typ_polozky = 3 THEN z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS cena_zup_typu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pojistovna_pohlavi, LAG(SUM(z.cena), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_cena_zup_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 203 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 340 AND SUM(z.cena) > 127285.1 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupine, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS celkove_poradi_delky, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS poradi_pojistovna_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 876 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 3751 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 241 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 110 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 568) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 37 AND SUM(z.cena) < 729179.42 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkove_body_vykonu DESC LIMIT 435;
