SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_polozek, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 74) AS max_body_vykonu_pro_pripad, (SELECT AVG(sub_z.cena) FROM zup sub_z WHERE sub_z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_z.typ_polozky = 87) AS prumerna_cena_zup_pro_pripad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_ve_skupine, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 283 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) > 114 OR COUNT(z.kod_polozky) > 741 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 46)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_komplikaci FROM pripady WHERE seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE '%I10%' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu) kompl ON p.identifikace_pripadu = kompl.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 209 AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 260 AND 861 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'J18%' OR kompl.pocet_komplikaci > 0) AND p.psc LIKE '1%' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 712 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 86 AND p.drg_skupina IN (395, 271, 73)) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 11 AND 22 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 5) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND NOT (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%') AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01') AND (v.body > 826 OR z.cena > 91283.9) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 46 AND SUM(v.body) < 409053 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 15 AND 95 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 51 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 92 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 14 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 35 AND body > 519 ORDER BY kod_polozky LIMIT 586 OFFSET 475 ) ) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.cena > 56400.08) > 81 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 813 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 60 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 627 AND SUM(v.body) > 15775 AND SUM(z.cena) > 11705.62 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 185 AND (p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 22 AND kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) OR p.identifikace_pripadu IN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 3495 AND datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zup WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND cena > 62609.16)) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 199 AND SUM(z.cena) > 980292.9 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) AS percentile_75_bodu_vykonu, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) AS percentile_90_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 17 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 4003 AND z.cena > 24267.45 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 12 AND SUM(v.body) > 934615 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) DESC) AS pozice_podle_nakladu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 120 AND v.body > 758 AND z.cena > 96995.46 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 974 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 3972886.95 ORDER BY celkem_zup_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesic_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 281 AND v.body > 246 AND z.cena > 44583.36 AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) NOT IN (0, 6) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 18 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 74 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC, mesic_prijeti DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 409 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) < 45568 ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 238 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 71 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE v.pocet > 86 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 91 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 15399.4 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 967 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS distinct_pripady, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 231 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 990 ORDER BY distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_propusteni IS NOT NULL AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 234 AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 5 ORDER BY propusteni_date DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 148 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.kod_polozky = 4863 OR z.kod_polozky = 5563) AND p.drg_skupina IN (832, 935, 621) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 94 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 25 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_vekovem_intervalu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 99 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 75 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_jedinecnych_diagnoz FROM ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, zakladni_diagnoza FROM pripady UNION SELECT identifikace_pripadu, UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz, ',')) AS diagnoza FROM pripady WHERE seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz IS NOT NULL ) AS vsechny_diagnozy GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) d ON p.identifikace_pripadu = d.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 352 AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 7731 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 55103.41 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 151813 AND SUM(z.cena) < 13554.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 18 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 18658 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.delka_hospitalizace > 194 AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' ) AND v.body > 3217 AND z.cena > 79439.37 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 796 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS zup_cena_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 337 AND v.body > 891 AND z.cena > 1723.81 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 197 AND SUM(z.cena) > 189784.8 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_polozky, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS zup_cena_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 274 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 640 AND SUM(z.cena) < 718434.39 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 307 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 356 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospitalization_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_days, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedure_codes, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_cost, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_material_units, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_by_hosp_days_per_insurer_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_quarter_cases FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu = z.datum_provedeni_vykonu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 187 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 722 AND z.cena > 1651.63 AND p.drg_skupina IN (134, 379, 691) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 510 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 502 ORDER BY total_hospitalization_days DESC, admission_year, admission_quarter;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 195 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 8810 AND z.cena > 96387.6 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= 2006 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (4, 2, 1) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 794 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 1496 AND SUM(z.cena) > 237505.71 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) DESC, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 293 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 66 AND kod_polozky = 9607 AND pocet > 17 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(body) > 5933 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 174 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 547 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, (SELECT MAX(v2.pocet) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 49) AS max_pocet_vykonu_pro_typ, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu_v_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 84 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 9 AND SUM(z.cena) < 426428.08 ORDER BY celkem_bodu_vykonu DESC, celkem_cena_zup ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS celkove_naklady_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 29 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 25 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_rank;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_polozky, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) DESC) AS rank_pacientu_dle_skupiny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 4810 AND z.cena > 91213.62 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 335 AND SUM(z.cena) > 901728.81 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS mesic_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne_a_drg, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS kumulativni_body_vykonu_po_mesicich FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 7 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '2 days' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 40 AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2) OR p.psc LIKE '1') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 599 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 8711 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 92 AND 22 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkove_naklady_zup DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace_srovnatelnych_pripadu, SUM(SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina ORDER BY p1.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = v2.typ_polozky WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 64 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v1.body > 689 AND z1.cena > 14685.14 GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) > 529439 AND SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena) > 9698004.48 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z1.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace_jine_pojistovny, SUM(SUM(v1.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina ORDER BY p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta = p2.vekovy_interval_pacienta AND p1.pohlavi_pacienta = p2.pohlavi_pacienta AND p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny != p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu AND v1.typ_polozky = 3 JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu AND z1.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 127 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 5601 AND SUM(z1.cena) < 9919.2 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC, celkova_cena_zup ASC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, (SELECT AVG(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 95) AS avg_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 350 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 9487 ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prumer_bodu_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 306 AND p.drg_skupina = 372 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 8961 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 27 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 678 OR SUM(z.cena) > 20826.79 UNION SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.kod_polozky = 6792 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.kod_polozky = 7578 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 67 AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) < 7083 AND SUM(z.pocet) < 895.4 ORDER BY drg_skupina, delka_hospitalizace;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS pohyblivy_prumer_nakladu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 165 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 77788.38 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.drg_skupina = 635 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-02' AND z.cena > 59142.2 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5608 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 13 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 324 AND p.drg_skupina = 808 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 776 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1) AS total_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 152 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 766 ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS prumer_vykonu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 1 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 2 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(*) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 236 AND v.body > 4501 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 INTERSECT SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(*) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 32 AND z.cena > 48380.62 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 25 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 INNER JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 99 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 33 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 123 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 758 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 25 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 807 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS pocet_pacientu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 202 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 468 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 187 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 184 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 141 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 904 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 62 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 13 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 4961 AND z.cena > 6065.26 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (216, 495, 956) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 91 AND SUM(z.cena) < 481943.91 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony vsub WHERE vsub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND vsub.typ_polozky = 50)) AS max_pocet_vykonu_druhu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_v_drg FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 276 AND (v.body > 9263 OR z.cena > 56994.27) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 832 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 30 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, rank_delka_v_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL) AS median_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.body IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_75_vykon_body, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.cena IS NOT NULL) AS percentile_90_zup_cena, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 88 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 28 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 9577 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 8206 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (665, 335, 802) AND (v.body > 967 OR z.cena > 47757.0) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 39 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 6 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkem_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerny_body_na_pripad, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_jednotku_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hosp_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 28 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 55 WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 509) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace IS NULL AND p.drg_skupina IN (110, 405, 183)) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND ( p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR (p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz IS NOT NULL AND p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'B00') ) AND NOT (p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta = '0-9') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 665 AND 122 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 347 AND SUM(v.body) > 906300 AND (SUM(z.cena) < 2480031.34 OR AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) >= 298) ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 307 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 65 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 3734) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 34 AND SUM(v.body) > 3239 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 199 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023) AND (TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > 17 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (291, 530, 866) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 431 AND SUM(v.body) > 90221 AND SUM(z.cena) > 603645.84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, SUM(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_delka_pojistovna FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 477 AND SUM(v.body) > 95677 AND SUM(z.cena) > 867424.55 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, SUM( (SELECT SUM(v2.pocet * v2.body) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 47 ) ) AS celkem_bodu_specifickeho_typu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 1 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 525 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 713089.76 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_nakladech FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 328 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 28 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 46 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 692355.68 ORDER BY celkem_nakladu_zup DESC, kumulativni_body_po_nakladech DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka) FROM (SELECT p2.drg_skupina, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS delka FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 778.2) AS sub WHERE sub.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina) AS prumerna_delka_drg_v_obdobi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 189.63 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 2588.22 AND SUM(v.body) > 628009.73 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 27) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu_typu, (SELECT SUM(z2.cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2024-12-31') AS cena_zup_obdobi, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 122 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2024-12-31' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 20002 AND SUM(z.cena) < 807355.08 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_body) FROM (SELECT v2.drg_skupina, MAX(v2.body) AS max_body FROM (SELECT p2.drg_skupina, v2.body FROM pripady p2 JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND v2.typ_polozky = 42) v2 GROUP BY v2.drg_skupina) sub WHERE sub.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina) AS max_body_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 219 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 842 AND SUM(v.body) > 247872 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 82)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 27 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 636895) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > (SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01') AND SUM(v.body) > 34806 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_celkova_cena, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 70 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 26 AND z.typ_polozky = 99 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 432 AND SUM(z.cena) > 476979.99 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu_dle_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 70 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 55 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 72 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 77 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING SUM(body) > 352048 ORDER BY SUM(body) DESC LIMIT 37 OFFSET 76 ) ) AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN ( SELECT identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina GROUP BY identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT identifikace_pripadu) > 7 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 172153 AND SUM(z.cena) < 2628862.41 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 100 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 87 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 325 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony v3 WHERE v3.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.body > 528 ORDER BY v3.datum_provedeni_vykonu DESC LIMIT 65 OFFSET 5 ) ) AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN ( SELECT identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND p2.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY p2.identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 58 AND SUM(v.body) > 628747 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, SUM(body) AS body_vykonu_typu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 81 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_zup_typu, SUM(cena) AS cena_zup_typu FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 11 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 102 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v_agg.body_vykonu_typu > 891 AND z_agg.cena_zup_typu > 8140.38 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 610 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 4468 AND SUM(v.body) > 637935 AND SUM(z.cena) > 1292936.29 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(sub.max_body_na_pripad) AS maximalni_body_na_pripad, MIN(sub.min_cena_na_pripad) AS minimalni_cena_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) DESC) AS dense_rank_hodnota_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, MAX(body_sum) AS max_body_na_pripad, MIN(cena_sum) AS min_cena_na_pripad FROM ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS body_sum, SUM(z.cena) AS cena_sum FROM vykony v JOIN zup z ON v.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu, v.typ_polozky, v.kod_polozky ) AS agg_sub GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) AS sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 728 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) BETWEEN 209996.34 AND 554211.62 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, rank_podle_bodu;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(z.cena) AS prumerna_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS poradi_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 340 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 4578 AND z.cena > 49112.7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 113 AND SUM(v.body) > 735676 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;
