SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 168 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 57 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 194 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 623 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC, celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_pripadech FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 24 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.body > 261 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v2.pocet) > 82 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 978 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupine, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS celkove_poradi_dle_delky, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS poradi_pripadu_v_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 80 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 55 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 189 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 634 AND SUM(z.cena) < 578857.84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 73 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 96 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vykonu_per_pripad FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky BETWEEN 4064 AND 7455 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, SUM(cena) AS celkova_cena_zup_per_pripad FROM zup WHERE datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 12 AND (sub_v.pocet_vykonu_per_pripad IS NULL OR sub_v.pocet_vykonu_per_pripad > 37) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 570 AND SUM(z.cena) < 763188.94 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rada_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 2 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 5904 AND z.cena > 70881.55 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 50 AND SUM(v.body) > 213624 AND SUM(z.cena) > 9344260.91 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS datum_propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_30d_skupina, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_zup_cena_90d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 309 AND v.body > 961 AND z.cena > 7738.25 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), DATE(p.datum_propusteni), p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 77 AND SUM(z.pocet) > 983.42 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 82 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 270 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 230 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 665 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 60 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 778 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) < ( SELECT AVG(body_sum) * 1.5 FROM ( SELECT SUM(v_inner.body) AS body_sum FROM vykony v_inner WHERE v_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v_inner.identifikace_pripadu ) avg_calc ) ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 90 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 229 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 20 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2) AS cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 316 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 20 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 1 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS specific_type_points FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 19 AND 266 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 138 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 9 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(z.cena), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_cena_zup_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 97 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 141 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (6415, 9883, 8279) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 343 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 103 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 11)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 239 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND (SELECT SUM(cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 40) > 980219.46 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 193 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 99 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS pomer_cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(z_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM zup z_inner WHERE z_inner.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z_inner.cena > 9376.35 ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (888, 950, 233) AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 263 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 4 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 85227 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_zup_naklady, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka) FROM (SELECT delka_hospitalizace AS delka FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza = p.zakladni_diagnoza GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu) sub) AS prum_delka_dle_diagnozy FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 LEFT JOIN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS cnt_diag FROM pripady GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) multi ON p.identifikace_pripadu = multi.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 121 AND 344 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny > 670 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 6987) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 507 AND SUM(v.body) > 387066 AND SUM(z.cena) > 73784.89 ORDER BY celkem_zup_naklady DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(v_max.max_body_za_pripad) AS maximalni_body_za_pripad, MIN(v_min.min_body_za_pripad) AS minimalni_body_za_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, MAX(body) AS max_body_za_pripad FROM vykony GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) v_max ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_max.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, MIN(body) AS min_body_za_pripad FROM vykony WHERE body > 0 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) v_min ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_min.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 73 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND v.kod_polozky IN (4230, 8018, 7780) AND z.cena > 74503.98 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 3 AND 2 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 607 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 28 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 10 ORDER BY celkem_bodu_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 55 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 673 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 376 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2018-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 100 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (108) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 90 ORDER BY rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti, celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(COALESCE(v.pocet * v.body, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(z.pocet * z.cena, 0)) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_pohlavi, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND p.drg_skupina IN (886, 898, 309) AND (p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 OR p.delka_hospitalizace IS NULL) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 651 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 14 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_podle_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 357 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN (SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 49 ORDER BY kod_polozky LIMIT 242 OFFSET 412) ) AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 968 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 8919) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 523387 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 5614198.93 AND 8254768.19 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_zup_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_v_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 INNER JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 135 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 6) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 88 AND SUM(z.cena) < 489059.76 ORDER BY celkem_zup_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS cena_na_den_hospitalizace, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 90 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 66 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 137 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 2636 AND z.cena > 89727.39 AND p.psc IN (SELECT psc FROM pripady WHERE psc LIKE '1%' GROUP BY psc HAVING COUNT(*) > 486) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 896 AND SUM(z.cena) > 67978.97 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 90 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pozice_podle_ceny_v_skupine;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS prumerna_denni_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet_pripadu, LAG(SUM(z.cena), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_cena_zup_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 312 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (366, 652, 265) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 738 AND SUM(z.cena) > 859528.07 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 36 ) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu_typu, (SELECT SUM(z2.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z2.pocet), 0) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 94 AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) AS prumerna_cena_zup_typu_od_data FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 138 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 29 AND SUM(z.cena) > 803980.78 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(v.pocet) AS avg_pocet_vykon, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 6167.79) AS pocet_drahych_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 94 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 6290 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 167 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 52780.81 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 134 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 333 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 738 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, ( SELECT SUM(v.pocet) FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 2 ) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 61 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND z.cena > 89222.54 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) >= 43 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 351 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 138 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 71 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 166 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (276, 463, 958) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 781 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, (SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet * v.body), 0)) AS naklady_na_bod, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) DESC) AS rank_naklady_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 197 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (264, 128, 267) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 7876 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 969313.39 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 34 AND 98 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, rank_naklady_ve_skupine ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 21 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 584 AND SUM(v.body) > 51239 AND SUM(z.cena) > 326687.52 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_a_drg, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_podle_veku_a_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 29 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 208 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 796 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 14104.87 AND 221859.36 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p2.delka_hospitalizace > 133 AND v2.body > 83 AND p2.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) > 4320 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 374493.97 ORDER BY celkem_nakladu_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 303 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 39 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 32 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 616 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 198 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 1 AND v2.kod_polozky IN (3317, 5288, 6529) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 10 AND z2.cena > 13640.26 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 60 AND SUM(v.body) > 8443 AND SUM(z.cena) > 175693.58 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) DESC) AS rank_hodnota_zup_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 307 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 3784 AND z.cena > 72477.47 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 866 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 7816343.08 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS prumerna_celkova_body_skupiny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 275 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 447 AND SUM(z.cena) > 366292.42 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_hodnota_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS pomer_cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(z_inner.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM zup z_inner WHERE z_inner.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z_inner.cena > 4079.83 ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (858, 591, 173) AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 329 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 239 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 64765 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 42 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 81116.53 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 32 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 220 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5649 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SELECT AVG(sub_p.delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND sub_p.vekovy_interval_pacienta = p.vekovy_interval_pacienta AND sub_p.pohlavi_pacienta = p.pohlavi_pacienta AND sub_p.drg_skupina = 662) AS prum_delka_pro_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 251 AND v.body > 5099 AND z.cena > 51552.85 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 506 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 229 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 252 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 598 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 100 AND 199 THEN 'Skupina_100_199' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'Skupina_200_299' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN 'Skupina_300_399' ELSE 'Jina_skupina' END AS kategorie_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 3 THEN 'Kratka' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Stredni' ELSE 'Dlouha' END AS kategorie_delky FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 346 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (804, 303, 863) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, kategorie_drg, kategorie_delky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 344 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 78 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospital_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_days, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedures, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_cost, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_points, SUM(SUM(z.pocet * z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_material_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.datum_propusteni >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 324 AND (v.body > 133 OR z.cena > 9440.32) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 81 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 76289.47 ORDER BY propusteni_date DESC, total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_celkova_delka FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 281 AND p.drg_skupina IN (952, 644, 518)) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 12 AND 151 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny NOT IN (9, 4)) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 274 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 683283.81 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_zakladnich_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_vekove_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 272 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 10 AND z.typ_polozky = 7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 421 AND SUM(v.body) > 55029 AND SUM(z.cena) > 382093.18 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 89) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 77) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_pripadech FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 127 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 473 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 5 UNION SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 69) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 59) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_po_delce FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 256 AND 287 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) < 707 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 1653 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.zakladni_diagnoza, p2.drg_skupina AS drg_skupina_self, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp_self FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.datum_prijeti < p2.datum_prijeti JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 222 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND p1.drg_skupina != p2.drg_skupina GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.zakladni_diagnoza, p2.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 78200 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v1.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.datum_prijeti < p2.datum_prijeti JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 161 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 239 AND p.drg_skupina = 136 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 51 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 273 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 2 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS specific_type_points FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 190 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 6959 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 48 OR p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 354 GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 936 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 5222 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 49 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 758745.52 AND 997713.99 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (859, 386, 922) AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 164 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 257555 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 294511.3 UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = v.typ_polozky AND z.kod_polozky = v.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (618, 628, 265) AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND (v.identifikace_pripadu IS NULL OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu NOT BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01') AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 248 AND 107 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 525 AND SUM(z.pocet) < 66.7 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, rank_po_poctu;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 339 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_pripad, SUM(z.cena) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_cena_zup_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu_ve_skupine, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 2 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 19 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 166 AND p.drg_skupina IN (980, 579, 170) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 92 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 41647 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 33 AND 27 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) AS podobne_pripady, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.drg_skupina = p2.drg_skupina AND p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 27 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.drg_skupina, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 53527 ORDER BY podobne_pripady DESC, celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 321 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_dle_bodu_v_drg_a_veku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 293 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 6508 AND z.cena > 93077.18 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 570 AND SUM(v.body) > 925676 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 5123224.19 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup, MAX(v.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS posledni_datum_vykonu, MAX(z.datum_provedeni_vykonu) AS posledni_datum_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS dense_rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 294 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 9010 AND z.cena > 53826.39 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 668 AND SUM(v.body) > 250572 AND SUM(z.cena) > 4856995.6 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC LIMIT 559;
