SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace_soubeznych, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p2.drg_skupina = p1.drg_skupina THEN p2.identifikace_pripadu END) AS pripady_stejne_drg FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 2 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 52 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) > 31 AND SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) > 15358 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 181 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 47 ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 106 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (212) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 438 AND SUM(z.cena) < 202533.61 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 129 ) AND p.delka_hospitalizace >= 218 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 17 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_pripad, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_jednotku_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_v_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 100 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 990 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 3157) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 922 AND SUM(v.body) < 516569 AND SUM(z.cena) > 698366.66 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 339 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 180 AND SUM(v.body) > 27458 AND SUM(z.cena) > 496244.43 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky AS typ_vykonu, z.typ_polozky AS typ_zup, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 99 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND v.body > 9223 AND z.cena > 7278.54 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta), (p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 37 AND SUM(z.cena) > 513941.2 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(v.body) AS prumer_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 330 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4652 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, rank_v_drg;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 301 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 146309.53 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 93 ) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 96 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 95 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 39 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_celkove_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_cena_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 192 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 9655 AND z.cena > 40608.57 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 716 AND SUM(v.body) > 978417 AND SUM(z.cena) > 3566008.59 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet * v.body), 0) AS pomer_cena_na_bod, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 128 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 8305 AND z.cena > 758.55 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 803 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 672774 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 2196545.19 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 188 AND p.drg_skupina = 847 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 82 ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, AVG(z.cena) AS avg_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 86 AND p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace < 48 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 42 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace ORDER BY total_vykon_pocet DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 100 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 865973.98 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 41 ) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 97 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2018-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 25 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2055 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 78 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 875 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 88 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 51967.86 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 663 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 192 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 748 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 77 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 459 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_po_pojistovne, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 257 OR p.drg_skupina IN (734, 497, 914) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 5864 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) OR p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 89514.85 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.pocet) > 93.43 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 588 AND SUM(v.body) < 685804 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 155 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 84) AS max_body_vykonu_v_pripade, (SELECT AVG(sub_z.cena) FROM zup sub_z WHERE sub_z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_z.typ_polozky = 22) AS prumerna_cena_zup_v_pripade, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_dle_drg, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS celkem_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 228 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (209, 517, 83) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) > 823 AND SUM(z.cena) < 877663.03 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 341 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2023) AND (TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > 23 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (516, 427, 462) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 427 AND SUM(v.body) > 88983 AND SUM(z.cena) > 685047.85 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS prumerna_cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v1.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v1.body * v1.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v1 WHERE v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v1.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z1.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z1 WHERE z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 5932.65 ) GROUP BY z1.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 250 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 721 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 65402 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 32 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta UNION SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 56 AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_celkova_delka FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 178 AND p.drg_skupina IN (826, 877, 353)) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 10 AND 261 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny NOT IN (6, 6)) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' AND p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 304 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 400769.18 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_pripadech, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 4 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 794 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.cena > 67664.46 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 525 AND SUM(v.body) > 20222 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS avg_body_per_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 27 AND v.body > 496 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_procedures FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 282 AND v.pocet >= 23 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.body) > 92055 ORDER BY total_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 193 AND v.pocet >= 41 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_nakladu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 181 AND 213 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (291) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 22 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 35 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 791 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 128 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 2 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 434 AND SUM(v.body) > 67475 AND SUM(z.cena) > 7850.35 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_cene, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_cena_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 7 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (940, 624, 662) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 360278.69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 51 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_bodu_30_dni FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 11 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (1431, 3421, 1710) AND v.pocet > 67 AND z.cena > 6487.49 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 318 AND SUM(v.body) > 26639 AND SUM(z.cena) > 155721.23 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, (SUM(v.pocet * v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0)) AS body_na_den, (SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0)) AS prumerny_naklad_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina > 440 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 7 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 158 AND 33 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 799 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5222 AND (SUM(v.pocet * v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0)) < 88.43 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, RANK() OVER HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 397 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) < 272409 UNION SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(v.body) AS prumer_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 44 AND p.drg_skupina = 104 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 72 ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena, AVG(z.pocet) AS prumer_mnozstvi_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 178 AND p.drg_skupina IN (944, 195) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v_sub WHERE v_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v_sub.body > 107 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z_sub WHERE z_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z_sub.cena > 80525.15 ) ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2600 OR SUM(z.cena) > 49255.46 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC NULLS LAST, pocet_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 3 THEN 'krátká' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'střední' ELSE 'dlouhá' END AS kategorie_delky_hosp, CASE WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' THEN 'muž' WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'F' THEN 'žena' ELSE 'neuvedeno' END AS pohlavi_text FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.drg_skupina = 201 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 41428.43 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 250 AND v.pocet >= 38 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 329 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 901 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 206 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 97 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 499 ORDER BY celkem_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 145 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (v.pocet * v.body)) AS percentile_75_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (z.pocet * z.cena)) AS percentile_90_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sub_p.identifikator_pacienta) FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND sub_p.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND sub_p.delka_hospitalizace > 76) AS pocet_pacientu_dlouha_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 4 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.datum_prijeti < p.datum_prijeti WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 32 AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 3763) AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 21 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) < 763160 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 15 AND 40 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 84 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS celkove_body_typu, COUNT(CASE WHEN z.typ_polozky = 99 THEN 1 END) AS pocet_zup_typu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT SUM(v2.body) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01')) AS max_body_pripadu_od_data, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 103 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 382 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) < 964764.84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_delka_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 77)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 359 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > (SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND pohlavi_pacienta = p.pohlavi_pacienta AND datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01') AND SUM(v.body) > 128104 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 275 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 7 AND v2.kod_polozky IN (7690, 7512, 4225) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 2 AND z2.cena > 31114.74 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 35 AND SUM(v.body) > 5965 AND SUM(z.cena) > 166102.12 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_po_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 138 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 275 AND SUM(v.body) > 817428 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, rank_poctu_pripadu;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky AS typ_vykonu, z.typ_polozky AS typ_zup, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS grouping_id FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 122 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 880 AND z.cena > 47342.24 AND p.drg_skupina IN (471, 970, 361) GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 164 AND SUM(z.cena) < 5377132.4 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, grouping_id;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 145 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 58 ORDER BY unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 182 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pripady_dlouhe_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 6570 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.kod_polozky = 3031 THEN z.pocet * z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 5 AND 117 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 295 AND 313 THEN 'Skupina B' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS klasifikace_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 310 THEN 'Dlouhá hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 22 AND 7 THEN 'Střední hospitalizace' ELSE 'Krátká hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 5 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS body_vykonu_typu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.typ_polozky = 9 THEN z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS cena_zup_typu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 11 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, klasifikace_drg, kategorie_delky_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 194 AND SUM(v.body) > 113423 AND SUM(z.cena) > 7890014.75 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne_drg ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 99 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 61 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_vykonu_per_pripad FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky BETWEEN 7642 AND 9523 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, SUM(cena) AS celkova_cena_zup_per_pripad FROM zup WHERE datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) sub_z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub_z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 259 AND (sub_v.pocet_vykonu_per_pripad IS NULL OR sub_v.pocet_vykonu_per_pripad > 5) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 673 AND SUM(z.cena) < 153959.51 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykony, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 35) AS posledni_datum_vykonu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_podle_skupiny FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 35 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 273 AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT DISTINCT sub_p.drg_skupina FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 178 AND sub_p.delka_hospitalizace >= 58) AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN (SELECT sub_p2.identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady sub_p2 WHERE sub_p2.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' GROUP BY sub_p2.identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(*) > 7) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4864 AND (SUM(z.cena) > 32513.5 OR SUM(z.cena) IS NULL) ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_delka_podle_skupiny ASC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prum_delka_hosp_30d, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) OVER(PARTITION BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pacient_celkem_pripadu, SUM(SUM(z.cena)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pojistovna_cena_90d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.datum_prijeti IS NOT NULL AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NOT NULL WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 85 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (535, 148, 396) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 843339.41 AND SUM(v.body) > 71605 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS total_procedures, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_cost_30d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 54 AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 3049.56 ORDER BY rolling_avg_cost_30d DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 65 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 217 OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND identifikace_pripadu != p.identifikace_pripadu) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vykony WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND body > 6602) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zup WHERE identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND cena > 666790.39) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 88 AND SUM(v.body) > 54188 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu_po_skupine ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, MAX((SELECT SUM(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 7 GROUP BY sub_v.identifikace_pripadu)) AS max_body_za_typ_v_pripadu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_podle_drg FROM pripady p INNER JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 88 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 302 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 387 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 1238) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 997464 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) >= 676 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rank_delka_podle_drg;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS agregovane_diagnozy FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 485 AND z.cena > 82138.43 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 473 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 1544 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 169 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.body > 673 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(z.cena) IS NOT NULL AND SUM(z.cena) > 352267.6 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalizace, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 96) AS distinct_vykon_kody, (SELECT SUM(z2.pocet) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 31 AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AS filtered_zup_pocet FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 291 LEFT JOIN vykony v3 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v3.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.kod_polozky = 3802 LEFT JOIN zup z4 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z4.identifikace_pripadu AND z4.kod_polozky = 9803 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 221 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.body > 176 OR z.pocet > 52.64) AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta IN ('0-18', '0-18') GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 19 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 292 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, avg_hospitalizace ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_zakladnich_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) / NULLIF(SUM(v.pocet), 0) AS prumerne_body_na_vykon, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(z.pocet), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_zup_polozku, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_dle_delky_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina = 581 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu = z.datum_provedeni_vykonu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 15 AND SUM(v.body) > 451187 AND SUM(z.cena) > 4080765.3 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;
