SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.zakladni_diagnoza, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(z.cena) AS prumerna_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 221 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.zakladni_diagnoza, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 320 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 18 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS kumulativni_cena_po_skupine, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_celkova_delka FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 8 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 15 AND p.drg_skupina IN (856, 973, 511)) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 9 AND 188 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny NOT IN (747, 262)) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni IS NULL) AND ( v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 54 AND SUM(v.body) >= 842259 AND (SUM(z.cena) < 8437287.76 OR AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 304) ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1 INNER JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 545 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 279 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 350 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' OR p.datum_prijeti IS NULL) AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 587) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 98 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 3626 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupine, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS celkove_poradi_delky FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 33 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 1346 AND z.cena > 412012.54 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 743 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 1500 AND SUM(z.cena) > 685179.81 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_zup_naklady, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka) FROM (SELECT delka_hospitalizace AS delka FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza = p.zakladni_diagnoza GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu) sub) AS prum_delka_dle_diagnozy FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 7 LEFT JOIN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS cnt_diag FROM pripady GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) multi ON p.identifikace_pripadu = multi.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 81 AND 43 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny > 689 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 1573) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 717 AND SUM(v.body) > 155641 AND SUM(z.cena) > 270885.0 ORDER BY celkem_zup_naklady DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v_sub WHERE v_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v_sub.typ_polozky = 70 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z_sub WHERE z_sub.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z_sub.kod_polozky = 5038 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 199 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 77) AS pocet_vykonu_typu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 48) AS pocet_zup_typu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_bodu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 80 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 431 AND SUM(v.body) > 479675 AND SUM(z.cena) > 2178670.15 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 9) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 10) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 58 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 952 AND SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 18922 UNION SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.typ_polozky = 5) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.typ_polozky = 7) AS celkove_naklady_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2019-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2019-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti <= '2019-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace < 97 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) < 132 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 4401.8 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena, COUNT(*) AS pocet_polozek FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 155 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN ( SELECT p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina GROUP BY p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 42 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 47431 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 72 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky) AS predchozi_body_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 293 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 128 AND SUM(v.body) > 68763 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_p1, SUM(v1.body) AS celkove_body_p1, COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykony_p2, SUM(v2.body) AS celkove_body_p2, SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup_p1, SUM(z2.cena * z2.pocet) AS celkova_cena_zup_p2, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg_vek, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY (SUM(v1.body) + SUM(v2.body)) DESC) AS celkove_body_rank FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p2.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND p1.pohlavi_pacienta = p2.pohlavi_pacienta AND p1.identifikace_pripadu < p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 173 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 302 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikace_pripadu, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, p1.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v1.body) > 80852 AND SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) > 135743.3 ORDER BY celkove_body_rank;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 195 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 1707 OR SUM(v.body) IS NULL ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, AVG(v.body) AS avg_vykon_body, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.kod_polozky) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 6 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) AS distinct_vykon_codes_for_case, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS cost_rank_in_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 73 AND p.datum_prijeti BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (559, 284, 384) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 160042.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) >= 63 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, p.identifikace_pripadu;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS pohyblivy_prumer_ceny FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 212 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 586463.18 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, COUNT(DISTINCT v.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu_s_vykonem FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 264 AND v.body > 532 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_procedures FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 37 AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 715 ORDER BY propusteni_date DESC, total_procedures DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 272 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 433 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 144 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 90 AND v2.kod_polozky = 2051 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 93 AND z2.kod_polozky = 2334 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 8 AND SUM(v.body) > 498626 AND SUM(z.cena) > 244548.19 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_dle_bodu_v_drg_a_veku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 340 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 386 AND SUM(v.body) > 86322 AND SUM(z.cena) > 254859.18 ORDER BY celkove_body_vykonu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE (p.delka_hospitalizace > 347 AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny AND delka_hospitalizace > 144 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 706)) OR (p.identifikace_pripadu IN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 8250 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(pocet) > 60)) OR (p.identifikace_pripadu IN (SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 49534.76 AND datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING AVG(cena) > 1892.12)) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 187744 AND SUM(z.cena) > 6519594.94 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(v_max.max_body_za_pripad) AS maximalni_body_za_pripad, MIN(v_min.min_body_za_pripad) AS minimalni_body_za_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, MAX(body) AS max_body_za_pripad FROM vykony GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) v_max ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_max.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, MIN(body) AS min_body_za_pripad FROM vykony WHERE body > 0 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) v_min ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_min.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 40 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2010-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND v.kod_polozky IN (9993, 1512, 9525) AND z.cena > 32812.53 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny BETWEEN 7 AND 7 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 116 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 26 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky AS typ_vykonu, z.typ_polozky AS typ_zup, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_uhrada_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 727 AND z.cena > 185.62 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (408, 457, 558) GROUP BY CUBE( p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, z.typ_polozky, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 554 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) < 268648.72 ORDER BY rok_prijeti DESC NULLS LAST, celkova_uhrada_zup DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkove_naklady_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, MAX(CAST(p.datum_propusteni AS DATE) - CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE)) AS maximalni_delka_pobytu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 234 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 67 AND z.cena > 62.15 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 845 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) > 383060.88 ORDER BY celkove_naklady_zup DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS cena_na_den, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_cena_v_skupine, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 140 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (696, 999, 122) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 237162.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 172 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 194 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5771 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, p.datum_prijeti;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prum_delka_hosp_30d, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) OVER(PARTITION BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pacient_celkem_pripadu, SUM(SUM(z.cena)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pojistovna_cena_90d FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.datum_prijeti IS NOT NULL AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NOT NULL WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 111 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (333, 683, 547) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 420795.38 AND SUM(v.body) > 37563 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS prumerna_cena_za_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body * v.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z WHERE z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2019-01-01' ) GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 306 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (690, 126, 764) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 483 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 63206 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 348 AND 627 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 4653 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, SUM(v.body) AS total_body, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS body_rank FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 332 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 9328 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, body_rank;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS klouzavy_prumer_bodu_30_dni FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 313 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (4168, 8689, 9146) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 77 AND SUM(v.body) > 994071 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, datum_prijeti_date;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) AS diag_prefix, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznych_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, SUM(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_delka_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 9 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 146 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') AND p.psc LIKE '1' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUBSTRING(p.zakladni_diagnoza FROM 1 FOR 3) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 835 AND SUM(v.body) > 69994 AND SUM(z.cena) > 466747.85 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 192 AND p.drg_skupina = 599 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 6240 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS datum_propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruznich_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_po_pojistovne_drg, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER(PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '15' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_30d, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS pozice_podle_ceny_zup_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 39 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 62 LEFT JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 9 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p2.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 5764 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 325 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 84328 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 851745.3 AND 900971.38 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pozice_podle_ceny_zup_v_drg;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.zakladni_diagnoza, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.delka_hospitalizace >= 146 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.zakladni_diagnoza HAVING SUM(v.body) > 9942 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS seznam_diagnoz, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 159 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 61 AND SUM(v.pocet) > 398 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 55 AND 179 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 285 AND 345 THEN 'Skupina B' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS kategorie_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 284 THEN 'Dlouhá hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 12 AND 2 THEN 'Střední hospitalizace' ELSE 'Krátká hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky, SUM(CASE WHEN v.typ_polozky = 7 THEN v.body ELSE 0 END) AS body_typu_vykonu, SUM(CASE WHEN z.typ_polozky = 10 THEN z.cena ELSE 0 END) AS cena_typu_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 20 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, kategorie_drg, kategorie_delky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 404 AND SUM(v.body) > 961051 AND SUM(z.cena) > 4631355.45 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 222 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 732) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > (SELECT AVG(body) * 3.0 FROM vykony WHERE datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AND SUM(z.cena) > 465205.55 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 38 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 68 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 3282 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 3828 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 89 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (SELECT kod_zdravotni_pojistovny FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = 992 GROUP BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(*) > 700) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 79 AND SUM(v.body) > 505198 UNION SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.pocet > 60 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.cena < 3283.17 WHERE p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 43 AND 886 AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN (SELECT identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A' GROUP BY identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT drg_skupina) > 5) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 959690.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 16 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, rank_poctu_pripadu;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_pojistovna_drg_vek FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 173 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 966 AND SUM(z.cena) > 938455.92 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS admission_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospital_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospital_days, COUNT(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza) AS distinct_primary_diagnoses, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_item_count, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_by_days_per_insurer_year, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS prev_quarter_cases FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 316 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2010-01-01' AND v.body > 1557 AND z.cena > 50169.38 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 103437 AND SUM(z.cena) > 726372.41 ORDER BY total_hospital_days DESC, admission_year, admission_quarter;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.zakladni_diagnoza, ', ' ORDER BY p.zakladni_diagnoza) FILTER (WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza IS NOT NULL) AS agregovane_diagnozy, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_ruzných_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 984 AND 691 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 563 AND SUM(v.body) > 19442 AND SUM(z.cena) > 2245953.71 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 76 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 9 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 8 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2443 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( p.delka_hospitalizace > 228 OR p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT p2.drg_skupina FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.identifikator_pacienta = p.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 96 GROUP BY p2.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 51 ) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 54324 OR SUM(z.cena) > 969453.12 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS ctvrleti_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 320 AND v.body > 249 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 73 ORDER BY rok_prijeti, ctvrleti_prijeti, celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 123 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (516, 627) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 9 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 278 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny), () ) ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 200 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 123866.84 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace), 0) AS prumerna_denni_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet_pripadu, LAG(SUM(z.cena), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_cena_zup_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 5 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 164 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina IN (756, 492, 134) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 294 AND SUM(z.cena) > 212168.51 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prum_delka_hosp_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 268 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 9 EXCEPT SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 3 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5506 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.identifikator_pacienta) AS prumer_vykonu_skupina FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 165 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 4 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 162 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 829 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 7 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 9 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, COUNT(*) AS pocet_jedinecnych_diagnoz FROM ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz, ',')) AS vedlejsi_diagnoza FROM pripady WHERE seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz IS NOT NULL AND seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz != '' ) AS rozsirene_diagnozy GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu ) AS d ON p.identifikace_pripadu = d.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' OR v.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND (z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu IS NULL) AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (225, 646, 247) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 292 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 63 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 167569.21 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, MAX(agg_v.max_body_za_den) AS max_denni_body, MIN(agg_z.min_cena_za_den) AS min_denni_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS max_body_za_den FROM vykony WHERE body > 94 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) agg_v ON v.identifikace_pripadu = agg_v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu = agg_v.datum_provedeni_vykonu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, MIN(cena) AS min_cena_za_den FROM zup WHERE cena < 76292.18 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) agg_z ON z.identifikace_pripadu = agg_z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu = agg_z.datum_provedeni_vykonu WHERE TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.drg_skupina IN (366, 810, 278) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 160 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 316 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, SUM(v.body) AS total_points, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_quantity, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unique_patients, (SELECT MAX(sub_v.body) FROM vykony sub_v WHERE sub_v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_v.typ_polozky = 70) AS max_procedure_points_per_case, (SELECT AVG(sub_z.cena / NULLIF(sub_z.pocet, 0)) FROM zup sub_z WHERE sub_z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND sub_z.typ_polozky = 70 AND sub_z.cena > 79657.59) AS avg_unit_cost_per_case FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 190 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(v.body) > 377919 AND SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 7196625.39 AND 7835016.05 ORDER BY total_zup_cost DESC, avg_hospitalization ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 931 GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 12 AND 197 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 42 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS distinct_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.drg_skupina) AS distinct_drg, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykony_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 236 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 27761 ORDER BY distinct_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 200 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 15 AND kod_polozky = 1045 AND pocet > 85 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(body) > 9155 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 319 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 264 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_body) FROM (SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v2.body) AS max_body FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu) sub) AS maximalni_suma_body_za_obdobi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 147 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 192 AND SUM(z.cena) < 466259.14 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p1.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z1.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z1.pocet * z1.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(p2.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace_soubeznych, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p2.drg_skupina = p1.drg_skupina THEN p2.identifikace_pripadu END) AS pripady_stejne_drg FROM pripady p1 JOIN pripady p2 ON p1.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p1.identifikace_pripadu != p2.identifikace_pripadu JOIN vykony v1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = v1.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z1 ON p1.identifikace_pripadu = z1.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p1.delka_hospitalizace > 288 AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 288 AND p1.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p2.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p1.identifikator_pacienta, p1.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p1.drg_skupina, p1.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p1.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p2.identifikace_pripadu) > 46 AND SUM(v1.pocet * v1.body) > 24559 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, celkove_body_vykonu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 259 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 4777 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 53 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 161 AND p.drg_skupina = 89 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 35 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 0) AS prumerna_cena_na_pripad FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 143 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND z.cena > 11119.19 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 14 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 INNER JOIN pripady p2 ON p.identifikator_pacienta = p2.identifikator_pacienta AND p2.drg_skupina = 412 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 52 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 11 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' OR p.datum_prijeti IS NULL) AND p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 711) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 74 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5861 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 121 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 394385 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 5008864.15 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 306 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 36056.84 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 16 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pocet_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 141 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 379 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 202 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM zup WHERE cena > 7044.83 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING SUM(pocet) > 5.94 ) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) > 225 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_uhrada_odhad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina > 360 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 365 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 24 AND SUM(v.body) > 101349 AND SUM(z.cena) > 502301.64 ORDER BY celkova_uhrada_odhad DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 231 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 374 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 374 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;
