SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 239 AND p.drg_skupina IN (200, 909, 464)) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 5 AND 3 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 7) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND NOT (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%') AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01') AND (v.body > 129 OR z.cena > 17487.6) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 986 AND SUM(v.body) < 291747 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 88 AND 99 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, rank_poctu_pripadu ASC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, ( SELECT AVG(sub_p.delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady sub_p WHERE sub_p.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND sub_p.pohlavi_pacienta = p.pohlavi_pacienta AND sub_p.delka_hospitalizace > 243 ) AS avg_hosp_length_similar_cases FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 1 AND 201 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 81 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 247 AND p.drg_skupina = 193 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 398 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 141 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 14 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(v.body), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_body_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 20 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 76 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 120 AND 284 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 56 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING SUM(body) > 6325 ORDER BY SUM(body) DESC LIMIT 82 OFFSET 53 ) ) AND p.identifikator_pacienta IN ( SELECT identifikator_pacienta FROM pripady WHERE zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY identifikator_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT drg_skupina) >= 6 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 897 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 69 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2010-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 954 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_po_pripadech FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 179 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 667 AND SUM(v.body) > 26443 UNION ALL SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, 0 AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, 0 AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS rank_po_cene FROM pripady p JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.identifikace_pripadu IS NULL GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 815868.45 ORDER BY kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, drg_skupina, rank_po_pripadech;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(v.body) AS prumer_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 215 AND p.drg_skupina = 913 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 62 ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, DATE(p.datum_propusteni) AS datum_propusteni_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina) AS avg_hosp_length_by_insurer_drg, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_body_by_insurer, SUM(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_propusteni) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_cost_by_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 13 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 89 LEFT JOIN vykony v2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.kod_polozky = 4707 LEFT JOIN zup z2 ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z2.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 4047 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_propusteni) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 354 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), DATE(p.datum_propusteni) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 41419 AND SUM(z.cena) < 734777.23 ORDER BY total_vykon_body DESC, total_zup_cena ASC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 214 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > (SELECT AVG(cena) FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 9) ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 52)) AS max_pocet_vykonu_typu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 124 AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 513 AND 140 AND p.datum_prijeti <= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > (SELECT AVG(delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady WHERE drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01') AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 29 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) FILTER (WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 0) AS median_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) FILTER (WHERE v.body IS NOT NULL) AS perc90_bodu_vykonu, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) FILTER (WHERE z.cena > 0) AS perc75_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 5 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-12-31' AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 88 AND 139 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-12-31' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 435 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 190 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.drg_skupina = 50 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 354 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 168 AND SUM(v.body) > 42987 AND SUM(z.cena) > 243035.56 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(sub.total_body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS total_body FROM vykony v WHERE v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 553 AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 5062.88 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.pocet) > 36.0 ) GROUP BY v.identifikace_pripadu ) sub ON p.identifikace_pripadu = sub.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 36 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 55 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 15 AND p.drg_skupina = 236) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace <= 2 AND p.drg_skupina != 989) ) AND NOT (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 4) AND (v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' OR z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 12 AND SUM(z.cena) < 736126.63 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 160 AND (p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' OR p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01') AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.kod_polozky = 9919 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v2.pocet > ( SELECT AVG(v3.pocet) FROM vykony v3 WHERE v3.identifikace_pripadu = v2.identifikace_pripadu AND v3.typ_polozky = v2.typ_polozky ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.kod_polozky = 6397 AND z2.cena > 97162.51 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 59 AND SUM(v.body) < 955666 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 37 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND ( p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 335326.13 ) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 15 ORDER BY celkem_body DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 132 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 767 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky) AS grouping_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 131 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 79 GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, v.typ_polozky) HAVING SUM(v.body) > 25426 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_cost_by_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 325 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.delka_hospitalizace, p.datum_prijeti HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 56866.36 ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 7465.02 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 557 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 28 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.cena > 63479.67 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 19 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 45 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS admission_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS total_hospitalization_days, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_days, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedure_count, SUM(v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_count, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cost, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_points, SUM(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 81 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND v.pocet > 13 AND z.cena > 319.37 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 406 AND SUM(v.body) > 642475 ORDER BY admission_date DESC, total_hospitalization_days DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 14 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 53 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(v.body) DESC) AS rank_v_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 203 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 999 ORDER BY p.drg_skupina, rank_v_skupine;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS pocet_unikatnich_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 6 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 3 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 362 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 700 AND SUM(v.body) < 963803 AND SUM(z.cena) > 806220.68 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT AVG(sub.delka_hospitalizace) FROM pripady sub WHERE sub.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND sub.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS prumerna_delka_drg_pojistovna, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 365 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2010-01-01' AND v.body > 1433 AND z.cena > 20669.09 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 31 AND SUM(v.body) > 930 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace_skupina FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 221 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_propusteni, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 2566 AND z.cena > 54657.81 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 412 AND SUM(z.cena) > 331441.84 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, rok_prijeti ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 152 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 253 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 100 AND 199 THEN 'Skupina A' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'Skupina B' WHEN p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 300 AND 399 THEN 'Skupina C' ELSE 'Jiná skupina' END AS kategorie_drg, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 7 THEN 'Dlouhá hospitalizace' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Střední hospitalizace' ELSE 'Krátká hospitalizace' END AS kategorie_delky FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 9 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, kategorie_drg, kategorie_delky HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 540 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 123 AND p.drg_skupina = 167 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) < 8886 OR SUM(v.body) IS NULL ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_vykonu ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 351 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 32126.66 GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.pocet) > 837.8 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 66 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 3 LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 8 WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 77 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 458 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina) AS prumer_bodu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 296 AND v.body > 2139 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING SUM(v.body) > 208 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 2 ORDER BY pocet_hospitalizaci DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(v_max.max_body_den) AS maximalni_body_za_den, MIN(v_min.min_body_den) AS minimalni_body_za_den, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS dense_rank_pripady_v_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 89 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 66 JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS max_body_den FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 44 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_max ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_max.identifikace_pripadu JOIN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu, SUM(body) AS min_body_den FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 26 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu, datum_provedeni_vykonu ) v_min ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_min.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 176 AND p.delka_hospitalizace < 67 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 4900 AND z.cena > 81404.7 AND z.pocet > 252.34 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A00' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A00') AND p.psc IN ('10000', '10000', '10000') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 51 AND SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 6341 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) BETWEEN 5 AND 36 AND SUM(v.body) > 38347 AND SUM(z.cena) > 85960.5 ORDER BY SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 117 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE kod_polozky IN ( SELECT kod_polozky FROM zup WHERE cena > 62468.89 GROUP BY kod_polozky HAVING SUM(pocet) > 200.52 ) GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(body) > 56 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 789 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 106 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 73 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS total_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_cases, AVG(v.body) AS avg_procedure_points FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 127 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 18 ORDER BY total_cases DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(v.body) + SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_v_drg_veku, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 10 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 2 AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 265 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 428 AND SUM(v.body) > 28139 AND SUM(z.cena) > 311399.71 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 323 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND (v.kod_polozky = 8309 OR v.kod_polozky IS NULL) AND (z.kod_polozky = 5487 OR z.kod_polozky IS NULL) AND p.drg_skupina BETWEEN 332 AND 965 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 430 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 169 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 740 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 961 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_po_pojistovne FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 313 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT v2.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v2.body) AS sum_body FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.typ_polozky = 80 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu ORDER BY sum_body DESC LIMIT 978 OFFSET 7705 ) AS top_vykony WHERE top_vykony.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu ) AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z2.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 27583.18 GROUP BY z2.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z2.pocet) >= 31.47 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 153 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 320 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 773 ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS pocet_jedinecnych_pacientu, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_jedinecnych_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 204 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 739 ORDER BY pocet_jedinecnych_pacientu DESC, prumerna_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_mnozstvi_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS kumulativni_body_po_zdravo_drg FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2019-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 322 AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 968 AND SUM(z.cena) < 283670.16 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 220 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE body > 423 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(pocet) > 16 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) >= 615 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.body > 447 ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 10 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 353 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 646 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS datum_prijeti_date, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_vykon_pocet, SUM(v.body) AS total_vykon_body, SUM(z.pocet) AS total_zup_pocet, SUM(z.cena) AS total_zup_cena, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS distinct_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS distinct_zup_kody, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_hosp_days, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.identifikator_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90' DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90d_body_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY SUM(z.cena) DESC) AS cost_rank_per_insurer_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 4 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 3 WHERE DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 174 AND (v.pocet > 91 OR z.pocet > 63.11) GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti), p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5069 AND SUM(z.cena) > 65264.92 ORDER BY total_zup_cena DESC, rolling_avg_hosp_days ASC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(SUM(v.pocet)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumer_vykonu_ve_veku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 97 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 5721 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, AVG(v.body) AS prumer_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 317 AND p.drg_skupina IN ( SELECT drg_skupina FROM pripady WHERE delka_hospitalizace > 25 GROUP BY drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(*) > 455 ) GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace > 256 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pripady_dlouhe_hospitalizace, SUM(CASE WHEN v.kod_polozky = 4316 THEN v.pocet ELSE 0 END) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 558 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 68 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 719940.85 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 144 AND p.drg_skupina = 736 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING COUNT(v.kod_polozky) < 92 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 195 AND p.drg_skupina = 222 AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.body) > 9559 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 6 ORDER BY pocet_hospitalizaci DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 242 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 54 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY p.datum_prijeti) AS pohyblivy_prumer_delky_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 34 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.datum_prijeti, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 79 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, (SELECT SUM(z.cena) FROM zup z WHERE z.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 10) AS cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 54 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 31 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) AS admission_date, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS total_procedure_points, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS total_material_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS case_count, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS avg_hospitalization_length, SUM(SUM(v.pocet * v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_points, SUM(SUM(z.pocet * z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY DATE(p.datum_prijeti) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_material_cost FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 299 AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) >= '2020-01-01' AND DATE(p.datum_prijeti) <= '2020-01-01' AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (809, 203, 581) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, DATE(p.datum_prijeti) HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 442504 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 227143.2 ORDER BY admission_date DESC, total_procedure_points DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 163 AND p.drg_skupina = 704 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.pocet) > 238 INTERSECT SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace < 124 AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny = 2 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(z.cena) BETWEEN 68689.38 AND 67401.31;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet * v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkem_nakladu_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 333 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.pocet * v.body) > 770373 AND SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) < 3528636.92 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE ( (p.delka_hospitalizace > 13 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 227) OR (p.delka_hospitalizace IS NULL AND p.drg_skupina IN (356, 288)) ) AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND NOT (p.pohlavi_pacienta = 'M' AND p.vekovy_interval_pacienta = '0-9') GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 379 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_drg_vek, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.pohlavi_pacienta ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS prev_pocet_pripadu_pojistovna_pohlavi FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND v.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND p.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL AND z.identifikace_pripadu IS NOT NULL WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 99 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2010-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 9 AND z.typ_polozky = 1 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 465 AND SUM(z.cena) > 167288.96 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) AS celkem_cena_zup, (SUM(z_agg.celkem_cena) / NULLIF(SUM(v_agg.celkem_body), 0)) AS prumerna_cena_na_bod FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v1.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(v1.body * v1.pocet) AS celkem_body FROM vykony v1 WHERE v1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY v1.identifikace_pripadu ) v_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v_agg.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z1.identifikace_pripadu, SUM(z1.cena * z1.pocet) AS celkem_cena FROM zup z1 WHERE z1.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= ( SELECT MIN(z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.cena > 1295.48 ) GROUP BY z1.identifikace_pripadu ) z_agg ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z_agg.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 129 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 922 AND SUM(v_agg.celkem_body) > 21352 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 144 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > 29734.31 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 317 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pojistovna FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 501 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 10 AND v2.kod_polozky = 2109 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 2 AND z2.kod_polozky = 3995 AND z2.cena > 55995.1 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 883634 AND SUM(z.cena) > 462555.31 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, MAX(CAST(p.datum_propusteni AS DATE)) - MIN(CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE)) AS casove_rozpeti_stacionaru FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 289 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 1084 AND z.cena > 91159.64 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 909 AND SUM(z.cena) > 897091.69 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 122 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny HAVING SUM(v.body) > 2620 OR SUM(z.cena) < 73062.49 ORDER BY celkove_body DESC;

SELECT p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_hospitalizaci, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND p.delka_hospitalizace > 95 GROUP BY p.identifikator_pacienta, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 8 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 23 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 444 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu =
