SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_pripadu_ve_skupine, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS kumulativni_pripady_pojistovny, AVG(SUM(z.cena)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS prumerna_cena_zup_ve_skupine_a_intervalu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 138 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2000-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2000-01-01' AND v.typ_polozky = 6 AND z.typ_polozky = 3 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 399297 AND SUM(z.cena) > 193299.56 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC, celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.pocet * z.cena) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 29)) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu_na_pripad, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka_hospitalizace, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS predchozi_pocet_pripadu_ve_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 150 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND (SELECT SUM(cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND z2.typ_polozky = 49) > 683627.38 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 968 AND AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 1 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, MAX(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v2.typ_polozky = 16 GROUP BY v2.identifikace_pripadu )) AS max_pocet_specifickych_vykonu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) DESC) AS rank_delka, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny) AS prev_pocet_pripadu_ve_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 302 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2010-01-01' AND (p.zakladni_diagnoza LIKE 'A%' OR p.seznam_vedlejsich_diagnoz LIKE 'A%') AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING SUM(v.body) > 408404 AND SUM(z.cena) > 698297.64 ORDER BY celkova_delka_hospitalizace DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) AS celkova_hodnota_zup, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) DESC) AS rank_poctu_pripadu, LAG(SUM(z.cena * z.pocet), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY p.drg_skupina) AS predchozi_hodnota_zup_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 114 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND v.body > 9419 AND z.cena > 53024.54 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 379 AND SUM(z.cena * z.pocet) > 280307.73 ORDER BY celkova_hodnota_zup DESC, rok_prijeti, p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 19 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 140 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 826 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delka_hosp, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.body) AS percentile_75_vykon_body, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY z.cena) AS percentile_90_zup_cena, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta) AS kumulativni_body_po_skupine FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 350 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu <= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 232 AND SUM(v.body) >= 598121 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_naklady FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 126 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 540 ORDER BY celkem_naklady DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS total_procedures, SUM(z.cena) AS total_cost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pripady p2 WHERE p2.drg_skupina = p.drg_skupina AND p2.delka_hospitalizace > 358) AS cases_longer_than_threshold FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace >= 118 AND p.delka_hospitalizace <= 289 GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 257225.55 ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, CASE WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace <= 7 THEN 'krátká' WHEN p.delka_hospitalizace BETWEEN 8 AND 30 THEN 'střední' ELSE 'dlouhá' END AS kategorie_delky_hospitalizace, AVG(v.body) AS prumerne_body_vykonu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 197 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.identifikace_pripadu, p.drg_skupina, p.pohlavi_pacienta, p.delka_hospitalizace HAVING SUM(z.cena) > 35723.29 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 188 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 5 AND SUM(z.cena) < 980679.47 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.delka_hospitalizace) AS median_delky_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 237 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.drg_skupina = 251 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 394 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 134 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) > 11 ORDER BY celkem_bodu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 322 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 858 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) AS unikatni_pacienti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS unikatni_pripady, COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_vykon_kody, COUNT(DISTINCT z.kod_polozky) AS unikatni_zup_kody, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkem_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_zup_cena, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_body_vykonu, MAX(CAST(p.datum_propusteni AS DATE)) - MIN(CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE)) AS casove_rozpeti_stacionaru FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = z.typ_polozky AND v.kod_polozky = z.kod_polozky WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 94 AND CAST(p.datum_prijeti AS DATE) BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND v.body > 2071 AND z.cena > 99018.77 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikator_pacienta) > 749 AND SUM(z.cena) > 746492.74 ORDER BY celkem_zup_cena DESC, unikatni_pacienti DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 190 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM zup WHERE cena > ( SELECT AVG(cena) * 0.98 FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 9 ) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 48 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 151 AND (p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT kod_polozky FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 56) OR p.drg_skupina IN (SELECT kod_polozky FROM zup WHERE typ_polozky = 78)) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 37 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp FROM pripady p WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 286 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT v.identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony v WHERE v.body > 134 AND v.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT z.identifikace_pripadu FROM zup z WHERE z.cena > 96064.23 GROUP BY z.identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(z.pocet) > 571.93 ) ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS rok_prijeti, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, COUNT(v.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, COUNT(z.kod_polozky) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup_mnozstvi, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, SUM(SUM(v.body)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS kumulativni_body_po_pojistovne_drg FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu AND v.typ_polozky = 1 JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu AND z.typ_polozky = 1 WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 99 AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE('2020-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny IN (724, 887, 795) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(p.datum_prijeti, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta), (p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina), (p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta), (p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 386 AND SUM(z.cena) < 751314.49 ORDER BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, GROUPING(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) AS grouping_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkem_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p LEFT JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu LEFT JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 58 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 755 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, SUM(v.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_vykonu, SUM(v.body) AS celkove_body_vykonu, SUM(z.pocet) AS celkovy_pocet_zup, SUM(z.cena) AS celkova_cena_zup, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.identifikace_pripadu) FROM vykony v2 WHERE v2.kod_polozky = 3966 AND v2.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01') AS celkovy_pocet_pripadu_s_vykonem, (SELECT SUM(z2.cena) FROM zup z2 WHERE z2.kod_polozky = 940 AND z2.datum_provedeni_vykonu BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01') AS celkova_cena_zup_pro_polozku FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 252 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.datum_propusteni <= '2020-01-01' AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' AND z.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, p.pohlavi_pacienta HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) > 432 AND SUM(v.body) > 16041 AND SUM(z.cena) > 417035.06 ORDER BY celkova_cena_zup DESC, pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prum_delka_hosp, SUM(v.body) AS celkem_bodu_vykonu, SUM(z.cena) AS celkem_cena_zup FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu JOIN zup z ON p.identifikace_pripadu = z.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 231 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' AND p.identifikace_pripadu IN ( SELECT identifikace_pripadu FROM vykony WHERE typ_polozky = 65 AND pocet > 21 GROUP BY identifikace_pripadu HAVING SUM(body) > 3320 ) GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.vekovy_interval_pacienta HAVING AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) < 91 ORDER BY celkem_cena_zup DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(DISTINCT p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace, ( SELECT SUM(v.body) FROM vykony v WHERE v.identifikace_pripadu = p.identifikace_pripadu AND v.datum_provedeni_vykonu >= '2020-01-01' ) AS celkove_body_vykonu_od_data FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 213 AND p.datum_prijeti >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, p.identifikace_pripadu HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.kod_polozky) > 3 ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;

SELECT p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina, COUNT(p.identifikace_pripadu) AS pocet_pripadu, SUM(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS celkova_delka_hospitalizace, AVG(p.delka_hospitalizace) AS prumerna_delka_hospitalizace FROM pripady p JOIN vykony v ON p.identifikace_pripadu = v.identifikace_pripadu WHERE p.delka_hospitalizace > 59 AND v.pocet >= 100 GROUP BY p.kod_zdravotni_pojistovny, p.drg_skupina ORDER BY pocet_pripadu DESC;
